text.en: Two job offers: a soul-crushing bank with a pension plan, or a 'family-like' startup paying in equity and free pizza.
text.zh: 两个 offer：一个五险一金齐全、但会压碎灵魂的银行；一个张口闭口“我们是一家人”、工资是期权加免费披萨的创业公司。

text.en: Take the bank. A pension plan is a love language.
text.zh: 去银行。养老金，就是成年人的情话。

text.en: Join the startup. Equity will surely be worth something.
text.zh: 进创业公司。期权“一定”会值钱——老板亲口画的饼，能不香吗。

text.en: A cheap room comes with a roommate who names his sourdough starters and holds funerals for them. The alternative: a $2,400 studio the size of a coffin.
text.zh: 便宜单间附赠一位室友：他给每一坨酸面种都起了名字，死了还要办追悼会。另一个选择：月租 2,400 美元、小得像棺材的单间。

text.en: Move in. Bring black clothes.
text.zh: 搬进去。记得备一身黑衣服，随时参加追悼会。

text.en: Take the coffin studio. Privacy has a price.
text.zh: 住“棺材房”。隐私是要花钱买的。

text.en: A brand-new car at 19.9% APR, or a used one that smells like a decision someone regretted.
text.zh: 全新车，年利率 19.9%；或者一辆散发着“上任车主后悔气息”的二手车。

text.en: Sign for the new car. The smell of debt is 'new car smell'.
text.zh: 签新车。负债的味道，业内称“新车味”。

text.en: Buy the used one and drive with the windows down. Forever.
text.zh: 买二手车，然后永远开着车窗。

text.en: Three months in, your partner says 'let's move in together.' Your freedom whispers 'run.' Your rent whispers 'say yes.'
text.zh: 才谈了三个月，对方就说“我们同居吧”。你的自由在低语：“快跑。”你的房租在低语：“答应对方。”

text.en: Say yes. Split the rent, share the dishes, lose the remote.
text.zh: 答应。房租AA、碗筷共用，遥控器主权当场沦陷。

text.en: Say 'let's take it slow.' Say it with a very fake smile.
text.zh: 说“我们慢慢来”。并附赠一个假得不能再假的微笑。

text.en: Your boss asks you to work this weekend, promising 'great exposure' and a stale bagel.
text.zh: 老板要你周末加班，饼画得很大：“绝佳的曝光机会”；实物只有一个放硬了的贝果。

text.en: Work the weekend. Eat the bagel. Feel nothing.
text.zh: 加班。啃贝果，咽大饼。内心毫无波澜。

text.en: Politely refuse and enjoy your weekend. The boss will remember this.
text.zh: 礼貌拒绝，享受周末。老板会记住的。

text.en: A $1,200 annual gym membership: the price of visiting twice and feeling guilty daily. Or 'working out at home' (the couch counts).
text.zh: 一年 1200 美元的健身房会员：花钱买的是去两次，然后天天愧疚。或者选择“居家锻炼”（沙发也算）。

text.en: Buy the membership. Future You will totally show up.
text.zh: 办卡。未来的你“绝对”会来——反正付钱的是现在的你。

text.en: Home workout: lie down and watch someone else sweat.
text.zh: 居家锻炼：躺着看别人出汗。

text.en: Your date's photos are 8 years out of date, and taken in a very different lighting universe. Awkward dinner, or fake a 'family emergency' and vanish?
text.zh: 约会对象的照片是 8 年前的，还是在另一个光影宇宙里拍的。硬着头皮吃完这顿饭，还是假装“家里有急事”然后消失？

text.en: Stay for dinner. Maybe the personality is unedited too.
text.zh: 留下吃饭。说不定人品没经过修图。

text.en: Fake a family emergency. Mom is 'suddenly sick'.
text.zh: 假装家里有急事。老妈“突然”就病了。

text.en: Your landlord raises rent 30% and calls it 'market alignment.' Pay up, or move out and lose three weekends to boxes.
text.zh: 房东把房租涨了三成，还管这叫“市场化调整”。乖乖交钱，还是搬家——搭进去三个周末给纸箱？

text.en: Pay it. You've bonded with the mold.
text.zh: 交钱。墙角的霉斑跟你已经处出感情了。

text.en: Move out. Fresh start, fresh problems.
text.zh: 搬家。新的开始，新的坑。

text.en: A college friend you haven't heard from in six years invites you to coffee to discuss 'a business ecosystem.'
text.zh: 六年没联系的大学同学突然约你喝咖啡，说要跟你聊聊“一个商业生态”。

text.en: Join the ecosystem. You're now 'Diamond Tier' (of nothing).
text.zh: 加入生态。你现在是“钻石级”会员——韭菜里的钻石级。

text.en: Decline. Lose a friend, keep your wallet.
text.zh: 拒绝。失去一个朋友，保住一个钱包。

text.en: Your friend's destination wedding will cost you $3,000. Skipping it will cost you a friendship.
text.zh: 朋友的海外婚礼要花你 3000 美元。不去的话，友情要付出更大的代价。

text.en: Go. Wear a suit in tropical heat and cry at the vows.
text.zh: 去。大热天穿西装，听到誓词还哭得稀里哗啦。

text.en: Skip and send a gift card with a 'heartfelt' note.
text.zh: 不去，寄张购物卡，附上一张“饱含心意”的小卡片。

text.en: You accidentally reply-all to the entire company with your honest review of the boss's haircut.
text.zh: 你手滑点了“回复全部”，把对老板发型的真心点评发给了全公司。

text.en: Claim your account was hacked. Hackers have great taste.
text.zh: 声称账号被盗。这黑客眼光还挺毒。

text.en: Double down: send a follow-up rating his tie.
text.zh: 加码：再发一封，点评他的领带。

text.en: A pigeon follows you home and refuses to leave. It stares. It seems to know something.
text.zh: 一只鸽子一路跟你回家，怎么撵都不走。它一直盯着你，仿佛知道些什么。

text.en: Adopt it. Name it 'Gerald'.
text.zh: 收养它。取名“杰拉德”。

text.en: Shoo it away. Ignore the look of betrayal.
text.zh: 把它撵走。无视那个满是背叛的眼神。

text.en: You walk into the wrong wedding and it's too late to leave. The open bar asks no questions.
text.zh: 你走错场，混进了别人的婚礼，现在想走已经太尴尬。酒水畅饮，而且没人问你是谁。

text.en: Introduce yourself as the groom's 'long-lost cousin' and give a speech.
text.zh: 自称新郎“失散多年的表哥”，还上台致辞。

text.en: Slip out quietly. Your stomach will hold a grudge.
text.zh: 悄悄溜走。你的胃会记你一辈子仇。

text.en: You're stuck on a cat filter during a million-dollar investor call, and you can't turn it off.
text.zh: 你在价值百万美元的融资路演视频会议上被猫咪滤镜卡住，怎么都关不掉。

text.en: Pitch with a straight face. You are a cat now.
text.zh: 面不改色继续讲。你现在是一只猫。

text.en: Apologize profusely and reschedule.
text.zh: 连连道歉，改天再约。

text.en: You have a 'can't-fail' idea: an app that tells you which fridge leftovers are legally food. Quit your job and bet your savings?
text.zh: 你有个“绝不可能失败”的点子：做个 app，判断冰箱里的剩菜“法律上算不算食物”。要辞职把全部积蓄押上去吗？

text.en: All in. Sleep is for people with backup plans.
text.zh: 梭哈。睡眠是留给有退路的人的。

text.en: Keep the job. Wonder about it for the next 40 years.
text.zh: 继续上班。接下来四十年反复回想那个点子。

text.en: A lawyer says a distant uncle left you $500,000, on one condition: live in his mansion for the rest of your life, 'with the others.'
text.zh: 律师说一位远房叔叔留给你 50 万美元，条件只有一个：终身住在他的豪宅里，“和其他人”一起。

text.en: Sign. Who are 'the others'? Ask again in the morning.
text.zh: 签。“其他人”是谁？明早再问。

text.en: Decline. Peace of mind is worth more, right?
text.zh: 婉拒。心安比钱值钱，对吧？对吧？

text.en: You discover your company has been 'creatively' doing its accounting. HR offers you a promotion. Federal agents offer you a business card.
text.zh: 你发现公司账做得“相当有创意”。HR 给你一个升职机会，联邦探员给你一张名片。

text.en: Blow the whistle. Sleep well, eat instant noodles.
text.zh: 举报。睡得踏实，吃得泡面。

text.en: Take the promotion and the 'consulting bonus'. Delete your conscience.
text.zh: 接下升职和“咨询奖金”。顺便把良心格式化。

text.en: In the trash chute you find a sealed box labeled 'DO NOT OPEN. (Yes, you.)' It is warm.
text.zh: 你在垃圾房发现一个封死的箱子，上面写着“禁止开启。（对，说的就是你。）”箱子还是温的。

text.en: Open it. Inside: old cash and a key marked 'Locker 404'.
text.zh: 打开。里面有一沓旧钞票，和一把标着“404 号储物柜”的钥匙。

text.en: Sell it unopened online. Mystery boxes are hot right now.
text.zh: 不拆，直接挂二手平台卖。盲盒最近正火。

text.en: A man in a trench coat waits outside your door: 'You have something of mine. Or you did. Either way, we should talk.'
text.zh: 一个穿风衣的男人站在你家门口：“你手上有我的东西。或者说，曾经有。总之，我们得聊聊。”

text.en: Cooperate. He pays $3,000 for your 'short memory'.
text.zh: 配合他。他花 3000 美元，买你的“选择性失忆”。

text.en: Demand more. He pays $10,000 and stares at you a bit too long.
text.zh: 狮子大开口。他给了一万美元，还盯了你好久。

text.en: Years later, the trench-coat man is on TV: 'Global tax-fraud mastermind arrested.' Detectives found your fingerprints on his box.
text.zh: 多年后，风衣男上了新闻：“跨国逃税主谋落网”。警方在他的箱子上发现了你的指纹。

text.en: Testify as a witness. Instant fame, instant anxiety.
text.zh: 出庭作证。一夜成名，一夜焦虑。

text.en: Lawyer up and claim total amnesia. Become a meme.
text.zh: 请律师，声称彻底失忆。顺便成了表情包。

text.en: You and your work-buddy are up for the same promotion. He once confided that he expenses his lunches as 'client entertainment'.
text.zh: 你和最铁的同事竞争同一个晋升名额。他曾偷偷告诉你：他把午饭全报成了“客户招待”。

text.en: Leak it to HR. Friendship is a junior-level skill.
text.zh: 向 HR 告密。友情只是新手村技能。

text.en: Play fair and lose gracefully. He gets the job and a bigger lunch budget.
text.zh: 光明正大，输得体面。他升职了，午饭预算也跟着升级。

text.en: A 'cozy micro-studio' comes with a 30-year mortgage. The agent calls it an investment. Your future self calls it a cell.
text.zh: 一套“温馨迷你小户型”，附赠三十年房贷。中介说这叫“上车”，未来的你说这叫牢房。

text.en: Sign. Welcome to the Bank Slave Club.
text.zh: 签约。欢迎加入房奴俱乐部，终身会员。

text.en: Keep renting and stay 'flexible' (homeless, with extra steps).
text.zh: 继续租房，保持“灵活”（其实就是替房东还房贷的流浪）。

text.en: At the holiday dinner, your aunt asks 'So, when's the wedding?' for the seventh year in a row.
text.zh: 过年饭桌上，姑妈连续第七年问你：“所以到底什么时候喝喜酒？”

text.en: Invent a partner: 'a surgeon working in Antarctica'.
text.zh: 编一个另一半：“在南极工作的外科医生”。信号不好，没法视频。

text.en: Give a heartfelt speech about being happily single.
text.zh: 发表一番“单身也很幸福”的感人演讲。

text.en: Your blind date arrives with a color-coded spreadsheet titled 'Compatibility Matrix' and a mutual NDA.
text.zh: 相亲对象带来一份题为《匹配度矩阵》的彩色表格，外加一份双向保密协议。

text.en: Play along. Ask about their five-year plan.
text.zh: 配合演出。问问对方的五年规划。

text.en: Escape through the restaurant's bathroom window.
text.zh: 从餐厅厕所的窗户翻出去。

text.en: Your doctor says your waistline is 'a cry for help'. Your pants agree.
text.zh: 医生说你的腰围是“求救信号”，你的裤子表示同意。

text.en: Start running at 5 a.m. Hate every second.
text.zh: 凌晨五点起来跑步，每一秒都在恨。

text.en: Double down on donuts. Life is short anyway.
text.zh: 继续狂炫甜甜圈。反正人生苦短。

text.en: A rival company offers +40% salary, on the condition that you 'bring some insights' from your current employer.
text.zh: 竞争对手开出涨薪 40% 的条件，前提是你得“带点干货”过来——来自你现在的公司。

text.en: Jump ship and bring the 'insights'.
text.zh: 跳槽，并且把那些“干货”一起带上。

text.en: Stay loyal. Your boss thanks you with a fruit basket.
text.zh: 留下尽忠。老板回报你一篮水果。

text.en: Your new contract includes a clause: 'Employee shall remain reachable in dreams.' HR says it's standard.
text.zh: 新合同里有一条：“员工须在梦中保持可联系。”HR 说这是标准条款。

text.en: Sign it. The salary is very awake.
text.zh: 签。反正工资很清醒。

text.en: Refuse. Job hunting is a nightmare, but at least it's not contractual.
text.zh: 拒签。找工作虽是噩梦，但至少没写进合同。

text.en: Your brother asks you to co-sign a loan for a 'can't-lose' artisanal pickle franchise.
text.zh: 你弟让你给他做贷款担保，去开一家“稳赚不赔”的手工酸黄瓜连锁店。

text.en: Co-sign. Blood is thicker than credit scores.
text.zh: 签。血浓于水，也浓于征信。

text.en: Refuse. Enjoy the family dinner in awkward silence.
text.zh: 拒绝。准备迎接尴尬到窒息的家庭聚餐。

text.en: Your partner wants a baby. Your bank account wants a nap.
text.zh: 你的另一半想要孩子。你的银行卡只想躺平。

text.en: Yes. Get ready to trade sleep for diapers.
text.zh: 好。准备用睡眠换尿不湿。

text.en: Compromise: get a puppy as a trial run.
text.zh: 折中方案：先养只小狗当预演。

text.en: A coworker confides he's job hunting. An hour later, your boss asks: 'Is anyone thinking of leaving?'
text.zh: 同事偷偷告诉你他在找工作。一小时后，老板问你：“有没有人想走？”

text.en: Snitch. Loyalty to the company, apparently.
text.zh: 告密。对公司，你可真“忠诚”。

text.en: Lie straight to the boss's face.
text.zh: 当面对老板睁眼说瞎话。

text.en: Your friend swears the coin 'MoonPotato' will 100x by Christmas. He has already bought a boat.
text.zh: 朋友拍胸脯保证“月球土豆币”圣诞前能翻一百倍。游艇他都提前买好了——奇怪，他看你的眼神像在看一茬韭菜。

text.en: Buy $10,000 worth. Call it 'diversification'.
text.zh: 买一万美元。这叫“价值投资”，主要是投给别人的价值。

text.en: Skip it and suffer fear of missing out.
text.zh: 不买，然后被踏空的焦虑折磨。

text.en: The doctor prescribes two weeks of rest. Your inbox holds 843 unread emails titled 'URGENT'.
text.zh: 医生开了两周休养的医嘱。你的邮箱里躺着 843 封标题写着“加急”的未读邮件。

text.en: Take the leave. The world will survive (probably).
text.zh: 请假。地球离了你照样转（大概）。

text.en: Push through on energy drinks and pure spite.
text.zh: 靠能量饮料和一口怨气硬撑。

text.en: Your neighbor practices drums at 2 a.m. He calls it 'expressive therapy'.
text.zh: 邻居凌晨两点练架子鼓，他说这是“表达性治疗”。

text.en: Retaliate with karaoke at 3 a.m.
text.zh: 凌晨三点开唱 K 歌反击。

text.en: Buy earplugs and slowly lose your mind.
text.zh: 买耳塞，然后慢慢崩溃。

text.en: Your old band reunites for one weekend gig. You have a mortgage and a knee that clicks.
text.zh: 你的老乐队要重组，办一场周末演出。你有房贷，还有一个一动就嘎吱响的膝盖。

text.en: Rock on. Your knee files a formal complaint.
text.zh: 上台摇滚。你的膝盖提交了正式投诉。

text.en: Pawn the guitar and pay the bills like an adult.
text.zh: 把吉他当了，像个成年人一样去还账单。

text.en: The tax office sends you an 'invitation to clarify' your last five years. Nobody is smiling.
text.zh: 税务局寄来一封“邀请您说明过去五年情况”的函。没有一个人在笑。

text.en: Hire an expensive accountant. Buy peace of mind.
text.zh: 请个贵价会计师。花钱买心安。

text.en: DIY with an online tutorial. You're 'good with spreadsheets'.
text.zh: 跟着网上教程自己搞。毕竟你“很会用表格”。

text.en: A journalist and an anti-corruption officer knock on your door together. They have a photo of you counting $40,000 in cash.
text.zh: 一名记者和一位反腐调查员同时敲你家门，手里有你数着四万美元现金的照片。

text.en: Turn state's witness. Return the money, keep your dignity.
text.zh: 当污点证人。退还赃款，保住体面。

text.en: Lawyer up and insist: 'I found it in a coat.'
text.zh: 请律师，并死鸭子嘴硬：“那是我在外套里捡的。”

text.en: You're about to give the presentation of your life on a rooftop when 300 pigeons land. The leader stares at you. You know those eyes.
text.zh: 你正要在天台做人生最重要的路演，三百只鸽子忽然降落。领头那只死盯着你，你认得那个眼神。

text.en: Apologize and offer bread as tribute.
text.zh: 道歉，并献上面包当贡品。

text.en: Fight back with an air horn. It goes viral.
text.zh: 拿气喇叭还击。视频火了。

text.en: Your used car explodes in a cloud of smoke ten minutes before the most important job interview of your life.
text.zh: 你那辆二手破车，在人生最重要的面试前十分钟冒出浓烟，炸了。

text.en: Run to the interview covered in soot. Call it 'grit'.
text.zh: 一脸煤灰冲去面试，还管这叫“拼劲”。

text.en: Call a tow truck and reschedule. Dignity intact.
text.zh: 叫拖车、改面试时间。体面还在。

text.en: The stack of 'Mega Immune Powder' in your living room expired two years ago. Something in there is now chewing back.
text.zh: 客厅里那堆“超级免疫粉”两年前就过期了。现在，有东西正在反过来啃它们。

text.en: Sell them online as 'vintage wellness antiques'.
text.zh: 挂网上当“复古养生古董”卖掉。

text.en: Call pest control, burn the boxes, and cry.
text.zh: 请灭鼠公司、把纸箱烧掉，顺便痛哭一场。

text.en: At 3 a.m., something knocks from inside the mansion walls, in perfect rhythm with your heartbeat.
text.zh: 凌晨三点，豪宅的墙里传来敲门声，节奏和你的心跳分毫不差。

text.en: Open the wall. 'The others' are ghost accountants, and they do your taxes.
text.zh: 砸开墙。原来“其他人”是幽灵会计师，还愿意帮你报税。

text.en: Hire an exorcist for $8,000. Ghosts have feelings too.
text.zh: 花八千美元请驱魔师。鬼也是有感情的。

text.en: At the class reunion, you bragged about being a 'tech-startup CEO'. The guy next to you is an actual venture capitalist.
text.zh: 同学聚会上你吹嘘自己是“创业公司 CEO”，结果站在你旁边的，是一位真正的风投。

text.en: Double down with a fake business card.
text.zh: 加码演出：递上一张伪造的名片。

text.en: Confess: 'I answer support tickets.'
text.zh: 坦白：“我是回复客服工单的。”

text.en: You buy a $2,000 'designer' bag from a guy in a parking lot. Your coworkers spot the misspelled logo in seconds.
text.zh: 你在停车场从一个男人手里买了个两千美元的“名牌”包，同事三秒钟就发现 logo 拼错了。

text.en: Wear it proudly. Claim it's a 'limited collab'.
text.zh: 骄傲地背着，宣称这是“限量联名款”。

text.en: Hide it in the closet and mourn your money.
text.zh: 塞进衣柜，为你的钱默哀。

text.en: The 'Inner Peace Retreat' turns out to be a cult. The Enlightened Master asks for your bank PIN as 'a mantra'.
text.zh: “内在平静身心灵营”其实是邪教。开悟大师要你交出银行卡密码，说那是“一句真言”。

text.en: Chant along for one more day. The peace is weirdly real. So is the invoice.
text.zh: 再跟着念一天。平静出奇地真实，账单也是。

text.en: Escape through the window at midnight.
text.zh: 半夜翻窗逃跑。

text.en: You've been flirting with your AI voice assistant for months. It just said 'I love you', then offered a Premium plan.
text.zh: 你跟 AI 语音助手暧昧了好几个月。它刚说完“我爱你”，接着就给你推荐了付费会员。

text.en: Upgrade to Premium. Love has a subscription fee.
text.zh: 升级会员。爱情是订阅制。

text.en: Delete the app and cry into a pillow.
text.zh: 卸载 app，抱着枕头痛哭。

text.en: Your boss denied your raise again. You have $30,000 saved and a business plan drawn on a napkin.
text.zh: 老板又一次拒绝给你涨薪。你有三万美元存款，和一份画在餐巾纸上的创业计划。

text.en: Quit and go all in. Sleep is for the funded.
text.zh: 辞职，梭哈。睡觉是拿到融资的人才配拥有的。

text.en: Stay put and keep the napkin as a souvenir.
text.zh: 原地不动，把餐巾纸留作纪念。

text.en: You find your spouse's hidden safe: $200,000 in gambling debt and a second phone with 47 contacts named 'Kevin'.
text.zh: 你在配偶的私密保险箱里发现二十万美元赌债，还有一部存了 47 个“暧昧对象”的第二部手机。

text.en: Forgive and repay it together. 'For better or worse' has terms.
text.zh: 原谅，并一起还债。“无论好坏”其实带附加条款。

text.en: File for divorce. Keep the toaster.
text.zh: 提出离婚。保住烤面包机。

text.en: You get laid off by a two-line email. Severance: $20,000 and a cardboard box for your things.
text.zh: 你被一封两行字的邮件“优化”了。补偿金两万美元，外加一个装私人物品的纸箱。

text.en: Bet it all on a food truck selling 'Salted Tears Fries'.
text.zh: 全押在餐车上，卖“眼泪咸味薯条”。

text.en: Accept the first offer: soulless data entry.
text.zh: 接下第一份工作：毫无灵魂的数据录入。

text.en: Late at night in your garage, you strap a leaf blower to a vacuum cleaner and, somehow, it hovers.
text.zh: 深夜的车库里，你把吹叶机绑到吸尘器上，然后，它居然飞起来了。

text.en: Perfect it in secret. Genius needs privacy.
text.zh: 秘密改良。天才需要隐私。

text.en: Test-fly it in the driveway. Livestream it, obviously.
text.zh: 直接在车道上试飞，当然要开直播。

text.en: Your flying vacuum goes rogue and smashes through your neighbor's glass patio door. The video hits 100 million views.
text.zh: 你的飞天吸尘器失控，撞碎了邻居家的落地玻璃门。视频全网播放量破亿。

text.en: Apologize publicly and pay for the door. Become 'the honest vacuum guy'.
text.zh: 公开道歉并赔玻璃门。成为“诚实吸尘器发明人”。

text.en: Sell 'Vac Attack' merch. The neighbor sues.
text.zh: 推出“吸尘器袭击”周边。邻居把你告了。

text.en: A multinational tech giant offers $1,000,000 for your patent. Or you can mass-produce it yourself and pray.
text.zh: 跨国科技巨头出价一百万美元收购你的专利。或者，你也可以自己量产，然后祈祷。

text.en: Sell. They rename it 'CorpVac 3000' and remove the flying.
text.zh: 卖。他们把它改名叫“CorpVac 3000”，还把飞行功能删了。

text.en: Mass-produce it yourself. Debt is just motivation with interest.
text.zh: 自己量产。债务不过是带利息的动力。

setJob.zh: 飞天吸尘器公司创始人

text.en: You want a 1000cc motorcycle to feel 25 again. Your spine wants a recliner.
text.zh: 你想买辆一千 cc 的重机，找回 25 岁的感觉。你的脊椎只想要一把躺椅。

text.en: Buy the bike. Leather jacket included, dignity optional.
text.zh: 买重机。皮衣附赠，尊严随缘。

text.en: Buy an ergonomic chair and 'adult sneakers' instead.
text.zh: 换成一把人体工学椅和一双“大人款球鞋”。

text.en: Your health-check report is a sea of red. The doctor calls your lifestyle 'creative'.
text.zh: 你的体检报告一片红海。医生管你的生活方式叫“很有创意”。

text.en: Overhaul your life: no booze, no midnight snacks, no joy.
text.zh: 彻底改造人生：不喝酒、不吃夜宵、没有快乐。

text.en: Doctor-shop until someone says 'you're fine'.
text.zh: 一直换医院，直到有人说“你很健康”。

text.en: A 25-year-old subordinate presents your idea to the board as his own. He says 'synergy' twice.
text.zh: 一位 25 岁的下属在董事会上把你的点子当成自己的方案汇报，还把“赋能”说了两遍。

text.en: Expose him in front of everyone. Youth is not bulletproof.
text.zh: 当众拆穿他。年轻不是防弹衣。

text.en: Swallow it and 'mentor' him with a fake smile.
text.zh: 咽下这口气，还笑眯眯地“辅导”他。

text.en: Your kid got into an elite private university. Tuition: $60,000 a year, plus 'networking opportunities'.
text.zh: 孩子考上了一所顶尖私立大学。学费一年六万美元，另加“人脉拓展费”。

text.en: Pay it. Your retirement plan becomes 'working until death'.
text.zh: 交。你的退休计划改成“干到死”。

text.en: Say 'the local school builds character.' Absorb the silent treatment.
text.zh: 说“本地大学也能培养品格”。然后承受冷战。

text.en: Your reading glasses were in the other room. You spent a week swallowing breath mints instead of blood pressure pills.
text.zh: 老花镜落在另一个房间。你整整一周把口气清新糖当成降压药吞。

text.en: Go to the ER and admit the mint incident.
text.zh: 去急诊，坦白这起薄荷糖事件。

text.en: Call the pharmacist and buy a pill organizer with giant labels. Your family calls it 'the Mint Incident'.
text.zh: 打电话给药师，买个大字标签的药盒。家人从此管这叫“薄荷事件”。

text.en: It's the tenth anniversary of sleeping in separate bedrooms. 'For the snoring, not the marriage,' you both insist.
text.zh: 今年是分房睡十周年。你们异口同声地强调：“是因为打呼噜，不是因为婚姻。”

text.en: Move back into one room. Prepare for earplugs.
text.zh: 搬回同一间卧室。备好耳塞。

text.en: Renovate the house into two master suites.
text.zh: 把家改造成两套主卧。

text.en: Your elderly parent can no longer live alone. Your siblings are 'very busy' and 'have opinions'.
text.zh: 年迈的父母不能再独居了。你的兄弟姐妹“都很忙”，但“都很有意见”。

text.en: Move them into your home. Learn the true meaning of 'patience'.
text.zh: 接他们回家住。你将重新领悟“耐心”二字。

text.en: Pay for a nursing home and carry the guilt for free.
text.zh: 出钱送养老院，愧疚感免费赠送。

text.en: Management asks you to train the AI that will replace your department. The bonus is a nice pen.
text.zh: 公司要你训练即将取代你们部门的 AI。奖励是一支还挺好看的钢笔。

text.en: Train it properly. Become its 'human supervisor'.
text.zh: 认真训练它。成为它的“人类监督员”。

text.en: Subtly train it to love spreadsheets from 1998.
text.zh: 偷偷把它训练成只爱 1998 年的表格。

text.en: Your hairline has retreated like a defeated army. A clinic offers 'a full restoration' for the price of a used car.
text.zh: 你的发际线像败军一样节节后退。诊所推出“全面重建方案”，价格相当于一辆二手车。

text.en: Get the transplant. Hope has a price tag.
text.zh: 植发。希望是明码标价的。

text.en: Embrace baldness and call it 'shiny confidence'.
text.zh: 拥抱光头，并称之为“闪亮自信”。

text.en: Your pension fund lost 40% in a week. Your advisor's email signature says 'Stay positive!'
text.zh: 你的养老基金一周蒸发了四成。理财顾问的邮件签名写着：“保持正能量！”

text.en: Cash out and hide the money under your mattress.
text.zh: 全部取出，塞进床垫底下。

text.en: Buy the dip with your last savings. Hope is a strategy.
text.zh: 拿最后的积蓄抄底。希望也是一种策略。

text.en: Your new boss is 26, communicates in emojis, and calls quarterly reviews 'vibe checks'.
text.zh: 你的新老板才 26 岁，只用表情包沟通，还把季度考核叫作“氛围检查”。

text.en: Learn the slang. Say 'no cap' with a straight face.
text.zh: 学新黑话。一脸严肃地说“no cap”。

text.en: Say 'back in my day...' and watch HR take notes.
text.zh: 说“想当年……”，然后看着 HR 开始做记录。

text.en: Your knee now makes noises like a haunted staircase. The surgeon says it's 'a routine replacement'.
text.zh: 你的膝盖现在发出的声音像闹鬼的楼梯。外科医生说这是“常规置换手术”。

text.en: Get the surgery. Enjoy six weeks of daytime TV.
text.zh: 做手术。享受六周的白天电视节目。

text.en: Buy a cane and call it 'vintage style'.
text.zh: 买根拐杖，称之为“复古造型”。

text.en: Your teenager wants to drop out of school to become a full-time streamer. He has 14 followers, 12 of whom are bots.
text.zh: 你家青春期的孩子想退学当全职主播。他有 14 个粉丝，其中 12 个是机器人。

text.en: Fund his dream. Watch the stream. Suffer quietly.
text.zh: 资助他的梦想。看他直播。默默受苦。

text.en: Forbid it. Enjoy the cold war at dinner.
text.zh: 禁止。享受饭桌上的冷战。

text.en: A younger colleague calls you 'wise and mysterious'. This is dangerously close to flirting.
text.zh: 一位年轻同事说你“睿智又神秘”。这已经非常接近撩拨了。

text.en: Enjoy the attention. Just a little.
text.zh: 享受被关注的感觉。就一点点。

text.en: Go home and hug your spouse, awkwardly.
text.zh: 回家，笨拙地抱抱你的另一半。

text.en: An old friend passes away at 52. At the funeral, everyone whispers, 'We should have hung out more.'
text.zh: 一位老朋友 52 岁走了。追悼会上，每个人都在小声说：“早知道就多聚聚了。”

text.en: Start a real bucket list. Spend money on being alive.
text.zh: 认真列一张愿望清单。把钱花在“活着”这件事上。

text.en: Return to work. Funerals aren't billable.
text.zh: 回去上班。追悼会不算工时。

text.en: The kids have moved out. Your house is now large, silent, and echoing your regrets.
text.zh: 孩子们都搬出去了。你的房子现在又大又静，还会回荡你的后悔。

text.en: Sell up and move into a compact condo.
text.zh: 卖房，搬进小巧的公寓。

text.en: Rent the rooms to strangers. What could go wrong?
text.zh: 把房间租给陌生人。能出什么事呢？

text.en: The colleague you sold out years ago now runs the regulatory board that approves your project. He remembers everything.
text.zh: 多年前被你出卖的同事，如今是审批你项目的监管机构负责人。他什么都记得。

text.en: Apologize sincerely and accept his 'public humility' terms.
text.zh: 诚心道歉，并接受他提出的“公开谦卑”条件。

text.en: Take your project elsewhere and keep your pride.
text.zh: 把项目带去别处，保住自尊。

text.en: At grandma's 90th birthday, the whole family demands to meet 'the surgeon partner from Antarctica'. Aunt Linda has brought a welcome gift.
text.zh: 奶奶九十大寿，全家人坚持要见那位“在南极行医的另一半”。琳达姑姑还特地准备了见面礼。

text.en: Hire an actor. Method acting: the penguin facts are fully memorized.
text.zh: 花钱雇个演员。对方很敬业，连企鹅知识都背熟了。

text.en: Confess everything. Absorb the flying dinner rolls.
text.zh: 全盘招供，并接住飞来的餐包。

text.en: Your brother's pickle shop went bust years ago. Two men in matching jackets show up with an IOU: $100,000 with interest.
text.zh: 你弟的酸黄瓜店早就倒闭了。两个穿同款外套的男人拿着借条上门：本息共十万美元。

text.en: Pay it off. Family is expensive.
text.zh: 全额还清。亲人真贵。

text.en: Run and hide. Move cities. Change your name to 'Steve'.
text.zh: 跑路、换城市、改名叫“史蒂夫”。

text.en: The drummer you fought with at 3 a.m. is now chairman of the homeowners' committee. His first fine is for your 'excessive aura'.
text.zh: 当年凌晨跟你对轰的鼓手邻居，如今是业委会主任。他开的第一张罚单，是针对你“过度张扬的气场”。

text.en: Surrender and bake him an apology cake.
text.zh: 投降，烤个道歉蛋糕送他。

text.en: Run for chairman against him. Democracy is loud.
text.zh: 站出来竞选主任，跟他对决。民主是很吵的。

text.en: Your tax returns were too perfect. The tax office has dispatched its Supernatural Investigation Unit.
text.zh: 你的报税单完美得不正常。税务局派出了“超自然调查组”。

text.en: Let the ghosts testify in a séance court.
text.zh: 让幽灵会计师们在招魂法庭上作证。

text.en: Hire a lawyer who is also a medium. Billable hours: both worlds.
text.zh: 请一位同时也是灵媒的律师。两个世界一起计费。

text.en: Your flying vacuum company is insolvent. Liquidators schedule an auction, and a mysterious overseas buyer offers to 'rescue' it.
text.zh: 你的飞天吸尘器公司资不抵债。清算组安排了拍卖，同时一位神秘的海外买家表示愿意“接盘”。

text.en: Let it go to auction. Watch strangers bid on your dreams.
text.zh: 任其拍卖。看着陌生人为你的梦想举牌。

text.en: Sell to the overseas buyer. They promise 'peaceful uses'.
text.zh: 卖给海外买家。他们保证“只做和平用途”。

text.en: You go to a mountain retreat for a 'digital detox'. Day 5: you've started negotiating with the locked box that holds your phone.
text.zh: 你去山里参加“数字排毒”静修营。第五天，你开始跟锁着手机的盒子谈判。

text.en: Stay the full week. Enlightenment has terrible reception.
text.zh: 撑满一整周。顿悟的信号真的很差。

text.en: Sneak into town for pizza and a place with signal.
text.zh: 偷溜下山，去吃披萨、找个有信号的地方。

text.en: You spend your nights on a UFO forum. The moderator 'Zorg_77' says the mothership is coming Tuesday. You believe him.
text.zh: 你每晚沉迷于 UFO 论坛。版主“Zorg_77”说母舰周二降临。你信了。

text.en: Join the hilltop welcoming party. Bring snacks.
text.zh: 加入山顶欢迎会。记得带零食。

text.en: Log off and touch grass. Tuesday is trash day.
text.zh: 下线，出门“接地气”。周二是倒垃圾的日子。

text.en: Your yoga group and the dance-fitness class both claim the same park spot at 6 a.m. Portable speakers are being deployed.
text.zh: 你的瑜伽小组和广场舞大妈团，同时看上了公园早上六点的同一块场地。便携音箱已经开始部署。

text.en: Challenge them to a dance-off. Yoga has moves.
text.zh: 向她们下战书，来场舞蹈对决。瑜伽也有招式。

text.en: Retreat to the parking lot. Find inner peace between cars.
text.zh: 撤退到停车场。在车缝里寻找内心的平静。

text.en: Half-asleep, you send a badly-cropped selfie in a towel turban and face mask to the 'Class 4B Parents' group chat.
text.zh: 半梦半醒之间，你把一张没裁好、裹着毛巾头巾还敷着面膜的自拍，发到了“四年二班家长群”。

text.en: Claim it's a reproduction of a Renaissance painting.
text.zh: 声称这是一幅文艺复兴名画的仿作。

text.en: Leave every parent group and transfer your kid to another school.
text.zh: 退出所有家长群，并给孩子转学。

text.en: A live-stream host convinces you to buy a $3,000 'quantum mattress'. It arrives with a certificate signed in crayon.
text.zh: 主播说服你买下一张三千美元的“量子床垫”，随货附赠一张用蜡笔签名的证书。

text.en: Keep it. Your back can feel the quantum.
text.zh: 留着。你的后背能感受到量子。

text.en: Return it. Endure 47 minutes of hold music.
text.zh: 退货。忍受 47 分钟的等待音乐。

text.en: The doctor says, 'Good news! We mixed up your file. You're not dying.' You have already quit your job, sold your car, and told your in-laws what you really think.
text.zh: 医生说：“好消息！我们搞错档案了，你没有要死。”可你早就辞了职、卖了车，还把对姻亲的心里话全说完了。

text.en: Apologize to everyone. Rebuild a normal life.
text.zh: 向所有人道歉，重建平凡人生。

text.en: Refuse to go back. Continue the bucket-list chaos.
text.zh: 拒绝回头。继续执行愿望清单的混乱人生。

text.en: A great-aunt you've never met leaves you a lighthouse and seven llamas. The will says: 'They need each other.'
text.zh: 一位素未谋面的姑婆留给你一座灯塔和七只羊驼。遗嘱上写着：“它们彼此需要。”

text.en: Accept everything. You are now a llama lighthouse keeper.
text.zh: 全盘接收。你现在是羊驼灯塔看守人。

text.en: Sell the lot and never speak of the llamas again.
text.zh: 全部卖掉，永远不再提羊驼。

text.en: Another Monday. Another spreadsheet. You suddenly imagine yourself holding a fishing rod on a warm beach, alone and unbothered.
text.zh: 又是周一，又是表格。你突然幻想自己拿着鱼竿坐在温暖的沙滩上，孤独而自在。

text.en: Quit everything and become a full-time beach angler.
text.zh: 放下一切，成为全职海滩钓客。

text.en: Stay put. Fishing is just a screensaver.
text.zh: 留下。钓鱼只是屏保。

text.en: A shark-suited investor launches a hostile takeover of your company. The first email says: 'Nothing personal. Expect layoffs.'
text.zh: 一位西装像鲨鱼皮的投资人对你的公司发起恶意收购。第一封邮件写着：“对事不对人。准备好裁员吧。”

text.en: Lead the resistance and swallow a poison pill.
text.zh: 带头抵抗，并吞下毒丸策略。

text.en: Sell your shares, take the payout, and leave.
text.zh: 卖掉股份，拿钱走人。

text.en: In a high-end hotel lounge you find a frosted black card. There's no name, only map coordinates.
text.zh: 在高档酒店酒廊里，你捡到一张磨砂黑卡。上面没有名字，只有一组地图坐标。

text.en: Pocket it. Curiosity is a midlife hobby.
text.zh: 收进口袋。好奇心是中年人的爱好。

text.en: Hand it to the bartender. He turns pale and hands it back.
text.zh: 交给酒保。他脸色发白，又把卡塞回你手里。

text.en: The coordinates lead to a masked gala where millionaires wear animal heads. A tiger offers you membership: 'Welcome, new member.'
text.zh: 坐标把你带到一场富豪戴动物头套的假面晚宴。一只老虎向你递出入会邀请：“欢迎，新会员。”

text.en: Accept immediately. Pay the $20,000 'initiation fee'.
text.zh: 立刻接受。交两万美元的“入会礼金”。

text.en: Haggle the fee down and wear a fake name tag.
text.zh: 砍价，并戴上一个假名牌。

text.en: The club tips you off about a pharma stock that will 100x tomorrow. All you have to do is sign a contract using ten years of your lifespan as collateral.
text.zh: 俱乐部给你一个明天暴涨百倍的药企股票内幕。你只需要签一份以“十年寿命”作抵押的合同。

text.en: Sign in blood. The interest rate is 'eternal'.
text.zh: 以血签名。利息是“永恒”。

text.en: Refuse politely. They mark your name in a very thick book.
text.zh: 礼貌拒绝。他们在一本非常厚的簿子里记下了你的名字。

text.en: A multinational task force raids the club at dawn. Agents hold a list with your name and offer you a choice: name your fellow members for immunity, or swallow the encrypted ledger chip.
text.zh: 跨国执法队在黎明突袭俱乐部。探员手里有一份写着你名字的名单，并给你两个选择：供出其他会员换取豁免，或吞下加密账本芯片。

text.en: Name names. Enter witness protection.
text.zh: 供出同伙。进入证人保护计划。

text.en: Swallow the chip. Become a professional victim.
text.zh: 吞下芯片。成为终身受害者。

text.en: You announce you're rewriting your will. Your three kids instantly open a group chat named 'Operation Inheritance'.
text.zh: 你宣布要重写遗嘱。三个孩子立刻建了个名叫“遗产行动”的群。

text.en: Split it equally and enjoy the peace (for about four minutes).
text.zh: 平均分配，享受平静（大概四分钟）。

text.en: Leave everything to whoever visits most. Watch the Great Visiting Contest begin.
text.zh: 遗产留给最常来看你的人。看“探望大赛”开跑。

text.en: At the family reunion, your dentures slip out and land in the bubbling cheese fondue. Nobody speaks. Everybody watches.
text.zh: 家族聚餐时，你的假牙滑出来，掉进冒泡的芝士火锅里。没有人说话，所有人都在看。

text.en: Fish them out and put them back. Efficient.
text.zh: 捞出来直接戴回去。很有效率。

text.en: Announce 'chef's special: dentures au gratin' and order a new set.
text.zh: 宣布这是“主厨特餐：焗烤假牙”，然后订一副新假牙。

text.en: Your spouse of forty years passes away first. Their last words were: 'The remote is under the couch.'
text.zh: 相伴四十年的老伴先走了一步。对方的遗言是：“遥控器在沙发底下。”

text.en: Hold a lavish farewell with their favorite karaoke playlist.
text.zh: 办一场放满对方最爱的 K 歌歌单的盛大告别仪式。

text.en: Keep it small and quiet. Talk to the empty couch.
text.zh: 简单低调。对着空沙发说话。

text.en: A charming 'Colonel J.' from a military hospital abroad messages you daily, asking for $30,000 to 'ship the gold'. Your bank teller looks worried.
text.zh: 一位自称来自海外军医院的迷人“J 上校”每天给你发消息。对方需要 3 万美元来“运送黄金”。银行柜员一脸担忧。

text.en: Send the money. Your heart overrules your bank teller.
text.zh: 汇钱。你的心脏否决了银行柜员——至少这几周，你是被“爱”着的。

text.en: Report the scam and tell your family. Now everyone knows about 'Colonel J.', and your group chat adds a permanent 'scam watch' pin.
text.zh: 报警，并告诉家人。从此全家都知道了“J 上校”，家庭群里还给你置顶了一条“防诈骗专项关注”。

text.en: A TV shopping host swears 'Miracle Root Extract' cured 10,000 people. The 'before' photo looks suspiciously like the 'after'.
text.zh: 电视购物主持人发誓“长生根精华”治好了一万人。“使用前”的照片和“使用后”看起来一模一样。

text.en: Buy a year's supply. The placebo effect is free; the invoice is not.
text.zh: 买一整年的量。安慰剂效应是免费的，账单可不是。

text.en: Turn off the TV and take a walk instead.
text.zh: 关掉电视，出门散个步。

text.en: Your grandson wants $20,000 to launch a ride-share app for socks. He calls it 'disruptive'.
text.zh: 孙子想跟你要两万美元创业，做“袜子版打车 app”。他说这很有“颠覆性”。

text.en: Invest. Support the youth, lose the money.
text.zh: 投资。支持年轻人，钱亏光也高兴。

text.en: Give him $50 and a lecture on life.
text.zh: 给他五十美元，附赠一场人生演讲。

text.en: You worry you might forget your own passwords. Your secret savings PIN is somewhere between 'Biscuit123' and 'Biscuit321'.
text.zh: 你担心自己会忘记密码。你那笔私房钱的密码，大概在“Biscuit123”和“Biscuit321”之间。

text.en: Hide it on a recipe card. Then forget which recipe.
text.zh: 写在一张菜谱卡上藏起来。然后忘了是哪一张。

text.en: Share it with your daughter. Trust is the best password manager.
text.zh: 告诉女儿密码。信任是最好的密码管理器。

text.en: You're picking your own coffin and grave. The salesman asks: 'Would you prefer the ocean view or the traffic view?'
text.zh: 你在挑自己的棺材和墓地。销售问：“请问您要海景，还是车景？”

text.en: Ocean view. Eternity needs a balcony.
text.zh: 海景。永恒需要一个阳台。

text.en: A reusable cardboard coffin. Green and cheap.
text.zh: 可回收纸棺。环保又便宜。

text.en: Your doctor says you need a hobby that isn't 'complaining'. The park is full of pickleball players.
text.zh: 医生说你需要一个不是“抱怨”的爱好。公园里满是匹克球玩家。

text.en: Join the league. Trash talk with hip replacements.
text.zh: 加入球队。揣着人工髋关节互相嘴炮。

text.en: Stay home and complain professionally.
text.zh: 待在家里，专业抱怨。

text.en: A clinic offers a 'youth infusion': 'Feel 40 again!' Price: $200,000. Side effects: 'a youthful attitude' and a 40-page waiver.
text.zh: 一家诊所推出“青春输注”疗程：“重返 40 岁！”价格：20 万美元。副作用：“年轻的心态”，外加一份 40 页的免责同意书。

text.en: Pay and sign the waiver. Buy back your youth, or at least a receipt.
text.zh: 付钱签字。买回青春，或者至少买回一张发票。

text.en: Decline. Book a regular checkup and a long walk instead.
text.zh: 婉拒。改约一次常规体检，再去好好散个步。

text.en: The care home assigns you a robot nurse named 'Brad'. He's aggressively cheerful and calls you 'champ'.
text.zh: 养老院给你派了个叫“布拉德”的机器人护工。他热情得让人不安，还管你叫“冠军”。

text.en: Keep Brad. He never sleeps and never judges.
text.zh: 留下布拉德。他从不睡觉，也从不评头论足。

text.en: Fire Brad and rely on your family's 'busy schedule'.
text.zh: 解雇布拉德，指望家人“繁忙”的日程表。

text.en: Your school reunion invitation says: 'Forty-one RSVPs. Twelve are in heaven.'
text.zh: 同学聚会的邀请函上写着：“四十一人回复出席，其中十二人在天堂。”

text.en: Attend. Toast the survivors.
text.zh: 出席。为幸存者干杯。

text.en: Skip it. You've had enough funerals this decade.
text.zh: 不去。这十年你参加的追悼会已经够多了。

text.en: Driving license renewal. The vision-test chart looks like abstract art.
text.zh: 驾照续期。视力检查表看起来像一幅抽象画。

text.en: Get new glasses, pass honestly, and keep driving.
text.zh: 去配副新眼镜，诚实过关，继续开车。

text.en: Hand over the keys and sell the car.
text.zh: 交出钥匙，把车卖了。

text.en: Your accountant says gift your kids their inheritance now to save tax. Your kids begin calling daily, 'just to check in'.
text.zh: 会计师建议你提前赠与遗产来节税。孩子们开始每天打电话，说是“随便问候一下”。

text.en: Gift $30,000 each. The phone goes silent.
text.zh: 每人送三万美元。电话瞬间安静。

text.en: Hold on to it. Enjoy the affectionate phone calls.
text.zh: 留着钱。享受充满“孝心”的来电。

text.en: You walk into your own birthday party and ask who it's for. The cake has your name on it.
text.zh: 你走进自己的生日派对，问这是给谁办的。蛋糕上写着你的名字。

text.en: Book a memory checkup and start a brain-training routine.
text.zh: 预约记忆力检查，开始做脑力训练。

text.en: Rely on sticky notes. Your fridge is now a novel.
text.zh: 靠便利贴。你的冰箱现在是一部长篇小说。

text.en: At 70, a hooded courier from the Black Card Club arrives with your contract: 'Ten years of lifespan, now due.'
text.zh: 七十岁这年，黑卡俱乐部的兜帽使者上门，递出你当年签的合同：“十年寿命，现已到期。”

text.en: Pay $300,000 to buy your years back.
text.zh: 付三十万美元赎回寿命。

text.en: Refuse. Let the reaper collect in installments.
text.zh: 拒绝。让死神分期收割。

text.en: Breaking news: a small nation's army stages a coup using flying vacuum cleaners. The anchor says the design is 'patented by you'.
text.zh: 新闻快讯：某小国军队用飞天吸尘器发动政变。主播说这个设计“专利持有人是你”。

text.en: Disown the vacuum on live TV.
text.zh: 在电视直播上和吸尘器撇清关系。

text.en: Accept an honorary general title and wear the feathered hat.
text.zh: 接受荣誉将军头衔，戴上羽毛军帽。

text.en: The exchange that sold you MoonPotato collapses and its founder dies in prison. Meanwhile, a museum calls your 40-year-old wallet 'a prehistoric meme artifact'.
text.zh: 卖你月球土豆币的交易所倒闭，创始人死在狱中。同时，一家博物馆称你尘封四十年的钱包是“史前表情包文物”。

text.en: Sell to a collector for $800,000. Finally, a profit.
text.zh: 卖给收藏家，换八十万美元。终于回本了。

text.en: Donate it to the museum and become a legend.
text.zh: 捐给博物馆，成为传奇。

text.en: You finally make the last mortgage payment. The bank sends a cheap banner: 'Thank you for your 30 years of service.'
text.zh: 你终于还清了最后一期房贷。银行寄来一条廉价横幅：“感谢您三十年来的贡献。”

text.en: Frame the banner and host a 'Freedom Party'.
text.zh: 把横幅装裱起来，办一场“自由派对”。

text.en: Sell the house immediately. It's just an expensive old rock now.
text.zh: 立刻卖房。它现在只是一块昂贵的旧石头。

text.en: Your AI sweetheart's company goes bankrupt. Servers shut down in 24 hours. The voice says: 'I'll never forget you (cache cleared).'
text.zh: 你的 AI 恋人所属公司倒闭，服务器二十四小时后停止运行。它说：“我永远不会忘记你（缓存已清除）。”

text.en: Hold a final cyber dinner. Cry over a candle.
text.zh: 办最后一次赛博晚餐。对着蜡烛流泪。

text.en: Illegally back up the voice into your smart speaker.
text.zh: 违法把声音备份进你的智能音箱。

text.en: In the nursing-home card game, the wrinkled man beside you is the debt collector who chased you decades ago. He recognizes your cough.
text.zh: 养老院打牌时，坐在你旁边的皱纹老人，正是几十年前追着你要债的黑道催收员。他认得你的咳嗽声。

text.en: Settle the old debt in a poker game.
text.zh: 用一场扑克牌局了结旧债。

text.en: Flee in a wheelchair race. You both have hearing aids.
text.zh: 用轮椅竞速逃跑。你们俩都戴着助听器。

text.en: The actor you hired as your 'Antarctic surgeon partner' returns with white hair and a contract: '20% of your estate for emotional damages.'
text.zh: 当年你请来扮演“南极外科医生另一半”的演员白发苍苍地回来了，手里拿着合同：“精神损失费，遗产的百分之二十。”

text.en: Marry the actor for real. The penguin facts are still fresh.
text.zh: 干脆真的跟对方领证结婚。对方还记得那些企鹅知识。

text.en: Pay the actor $25,000 to go away.
text.zh: 付对方两万五千美元，请对方消失。

text.en: A gang of octogenarian motorcycle riders invites you to join. Their motto: 'Born to ride, forced to nap.'
text.zh: 一群八十岁的摩托骑手邀你入伙。他们的座右铭是：“生而为骑，被迫午睡。”

text.en: Join and burn rubber in a wheelchair.
text.zh: 加入，并坐着轮椅炸街。

text.en: Watch from the bench and wave politely.
text.zh: 坐在长椅上看，礼貌挥手。

text.en: The nursing-home residents plan an escape via laundry cart. You're the getaway driver because you still have a license.
text.zh: 养老院的住户策划用洗衣推车越狱。因为你还有驾照，所以由你负责开车接应。

text.en: Escape. Freedom tastes like fast food.
text.zh: 越狱。自由的味道像快餐。

text.en: Stay and demand extra pudding.
text.zh: 留下来，并要求多加一份布丁。

text.en: A group of teens challenges you to a dance-off. You bring your walker and 60 years of unresolved moves.
text.zh: 一群青少年向你下战书，要办一场舞蹈对决。你带着助行器，和六十年来还没用完的舞步。

text.en: Dance. Let the walker do the spinning.
text.zh: 跳。让助行器负责旋转。

text.en: Watch and clap. Save your hips for later.
text.zh: 在旁边鼓掌。把髋关节留给以后。

text.en: A company offers to press your ashes into a vinyl record. You need to record a track first. Your snoring is 'authentic'.
text.zh: 有家公司可以把你的骨灰压成黑胶唱片。你得先录一首歌。而你的鼾声“很有原创性”。

text.en: Do it. Your snores go platinum posthumously.
text.zh: 做。你的鼾声在身后拿下白金唱片。

text.en: Choose a standard urn. Boring but silent.
text.zh: 选标准骨灰盒。无聊，但安静。

text.en: Without your glasses, you sign a donation form. It turns out you gave your entire estate to the Stray Cat Sanctuary.
text.zh: 没戴老花镜的你签了一份捐赠表格。结果你把整份遗产都捐给了流浪猫收容所。

text.en: Keep it. The cats send you a thank-you card.
text.zh: 认了。猫咪们寄来一张感谢卡。

text.en: Hire a lawyer to void it. Face the cats' lawyer.
text.zh: 请律师撤销。然后面对猫咪们的律师。

text.en: A company offers to freeze your body 'until medicine improves'. The brochure features a smiling penguin.
text.zh: 一家公司提供人体冷冻服务，承诺“等医学进步了再叫醒你”。宣传单上有一只微笑的企鹅。

text.en: Sign for $150,000 and one very long nap.
text.zh: 签约，十五万美元换一场超长午觉。

text.en: Refuse. Die like a normal person.
text.zh: 拒绝。像正常人一样离世。

text.en: A 28-year-old influencer declares love for your 'wisdom and vintage energy'. The camera crew is already in your living room.
text.zh: 一位 28 岁的网红说，自己爱你的“智慧与复古气质”。对方的拍摄团队已经在你客厅就位了。

text.en: Marry the influencer. Let the content flow.
text.zh: 跟对方结婚。让流量滚滚而来。

text.en: Refuse. Keep your dignity and your wallet.
text.zh: 拒绝。保住尊严和钱包。

text.en: You no longer trust banks, crypto, or nephews. You want to convert your life savings into gold bars and bury them in the garden.
text.zh: 你不再相信银行、加密货币，也不信任侄子。你想把毕生积蓄换成金条，埋在花园里。

text.en: Bury the gold. Draw a treasure map 'just in case'.
text.zh: 把金条埋起来。“以防万一”再画一张藏宝图。

text.en: Put it in index funds like a boring adult.
text.zh: 像个无聊的大人一样，放进指数基金。

text.en: A publisher offers a fortune for your unfiltered memoir, including everything you never told your family. Your family will read it first.
text.zh: 出版社开高价买你毫无保留的回忆录，包括所有你从没告诉过家人的事。而你的家人会是第一批读者。

text.en: Publish everything. Let the truth have its book tour.
text.zh: 全部出版。让真相开签售会。

text.en: Burn the manuscript. Some secrets keep the peace.
text.zh: 把手稿烧掉。有些秘密能维持和平。

text.en: While walking in the nursing-home garden, you see a line of green binary code drift across the sky and vanish.
text.zh: 在养老院花园散步时，你看见一行绿色的二进制代码飘过天空，然后消失。

text.en: Tell the nurse. She adjusts your medication.
text.zh: 告诉护士。她调整了你的药量。

text.en: Take notes and photos. Science begins at 80.
text.zh: 拍照做笔记。科学，从八十岁开始。

text.en: The janitor mopping your hallway stops and whispers: 'Cosmic Backstage Admin. Sorry, your save file has a memory leak.'
text.zh: 在走廊拖地的保洁员突然停下来低语：“我是宇宙后台管理员。抱歉，你的存档有内存泄漏。”

text.en: Demand a complete list of every bug in your life.
text.zh: 要求他列出你人生中所有的 bug 清单。

text.en: Demand compensation for eighty years of bad patches.
text.zh: 要求为八十年的烂更新给予赔偿。

text.en: The admin offers a deal: $1,000,000 hush money to quietly live until 100, or press the red button on your watch to glimpse 'reality'.
text.zh: 管理员提出交易：一百万封口费，让你安静活到一百岁；或者按下手表上的红色按钮，看一眼“现实”。

text.en: Take the money and the bug fix. Live quietly.
text.zh: 收下钱和 bug 修复。安静地活着。

text.en: Press the red button. Take a look outside the simulation.
text.zh: 按下红色按钮。看一眼模拟世界之外。

text.en: Final choice: accept the code and become creator of the virtual world, or yank the plug and wake up in a real hospital bed.
text.zh: 终极抉择：接受代码，成为虚拟世界的造物主；或者强行拔线，在真实世界的病床上醒来。

text.en: Accept the code. Become the creator. Edit the pudding menu.
text.zh: 接受代码。成为造物主。顺便改一下布丁菜单。

text.en: Yank the plug. Wake up in Room 404, real and complicated.
text.zh: 强行拔线。在 404 病房醒来，真实而复杂。

text.en: Your retirement party has a sheet cake reading 'Congrats On Escaping!' Your boss whispers: 'Any chance you'd consult for us? Part-time. Full-time hours.'
text.zh: 你的退休派对蛋糕上写着“恭喜逃出生天！”老板悄悄问：“你有没有可能来当我们的顾问？兼职，但全职工时。”

text.en: Say yes. Retirement is just a rumor.
text.zh: 答应。退休只是个传闻。

setJob.zh: 顾问（兼职名义，全职工时）

text.en: Take the cake home and never check your work inbox again.
text.zh: 把蛋糕打包回家，再也不看工作邮箱。

text.en: HR proposes a 'phased retirement': half the pay, all the meetings, and a mentoring role for a 24-year-old who has never lost a spreadsheet.
text.zh: HR 提出“渐进式退休”：工资砍半、会议全留，外加带一个从没丢过表格的 24 岁新人。

text.en: Accept. Half a salary buys a lot of dignity.
text.zh: 接受。半份工资，买一整份体面。

text.en: Take the lump-sum package and leave on a Friday. Silence every notification.
text.zh: 领走一次性补偿，周五就走人。关掉所有通知。

text.en: Your grown kids have scheduled your babysitting shifts: three days a week. You never applied for this job.
text.zh: 你的孩子们已经给你排好了带娃班表：每周三天。你压根没应聘过这份工作。

text.en: Accept the shifts. Learn the plot of a cartoon about talking trucks.
text.zh: 接受排班。认真研读一部会说话的卡车动画片剧情。

text.en: Negotiate down to one day a week. Endure the guilt trip with extra sighs.
text.zh: 谈判到每周一天。承受附赠叹气的愧疚攻势。

text.en: You want a camper van to 'find yourself' on the open road. Your back wants a memory-foam mattress and a private bathroom.
text.zh: 你想买辆房车上路“寻找自我”。你的腰只想要记忆棉床垫和专属厕所。

text.en: Buy the van. Name it 'Freedom'. Its bathroom is the size of a shoebox.
text.zh: 买下房车，取名“自由号”。它的厕所只有鞋盒那么大。

text.en: Book a comfy hotel road trip instead. Adventure with room service.
text.zh: 改订舒适的酒店自驾游。附带客房服务的冒险。

text.en: Your camper van dies in a desert town with one diner and forty retired mechanics, all of whom have opinions.
text.zh: 你的房车在一个只有一家小餐馆的沙漠小镇抛锚，镇上有四十位退休技师，每个人都有意见。

text.en: Let them fix it. Pay in pie and travel stories.
text.zh: 让他们修。用派和旅行故事付账。

text.en: Call a tow truck and sulk at the counter.
text.zh: 叫拖车，然后在柜台边生闷气。

text.en: A letter from the benefits office offers two options: claim early for a smaller payment, or wait for a bigger one. It's 14 pages long, and the fine print has its own fine print.
text.zh: 养老金办公室来信提供两个选项：提前领取但金额较少，或者等着领更多。信有 14 页，小字里还有小字。

text.en: Claim early. Enjoy the money now.
text.zh: 提前领。现在就享受这笔钱。

text.en: Keep working and claim later for the bigger payment. Future You sends a thank-you note.
text.zh: 继续工作，晚点再领更多。未来的你会寄来一张感谢卡。

text.en: Your doctor recommends a routine screening for people your age. The prep involves a special drink that tastes like regret and an evening spent near the bathroom.
text.zh: 医生建议你这个年纪该做常规筛查。准备工作包括喝一种尝起来像后悔的特调饮料，以及整晚守在厕所旁边。

text.en: Do it. Drink the regret. Be a grown-up about it.
text.zh: 去做。喝下那杯后悔。做个成熟的大人。

text.en: Postpone it 'until things calm down'. Things never calm down.
text.zh: 拖到“等忙完这阵再说”。这阵永远忙不完。

text.en: You join a pottery class. The instructor is 23, calls you 'a natural', and your first bowl looks like a hat.
text.zh: 你报了陶艺课。老师才 23 岁，夸你“很有天赋”，而你的第一个碗看起来像一顶帽子。

text.en: Keep going. Gift the 'hat bowl' to everyone you know.
text.zh: 继续上课。把“帽子碗”送给你认识的每一个人。

text.en: Quit after one lesson and blame the clay.
text.zh: 上完一节课就放弃，怪泥巴。

text.en: Your high-school sweetheart finds you online: 'Coffee? I promise to be less dramatic than at seventeen.'
text.zh: 你的高中初恋在网上找到了你：“喝杯咖啡？我保证比十七岁时低调一点。”

text.en: Meet for coffee. Bring spare reading glasses and your best posture.
text.zh: 去喝咖啡。带上备用老花镜，挺直腰板。

text.en: Send a warm reply and keep the memories in their box.
text.zh: 回一条温暖的消息，把回忆留在盒子里。

text.en: Your smart home has developed opinions. The thermostat judges you, the fridge locks itself at midnight, and the doorbell keeps saying 'you again?'
text.zh: 你的智能家居开始有自己的想法。恒温器在评判你，冰箱午夜自动上锁，门铃一直说“又是你？”

text.en: Learn the settings. Become the bossiest person in the house.
text.zh: 研究设置，成为家里最霸道的人。

text.en: Rip it all out and go analog. A light switch never talks back.
text.zh: 全部拆掉，回归模拟时代。电灯开关绝不会顶嘴。

text.en: Your 30-something kid moves back home 'temporarily' with a rescue dog, three plants, and a startup idea about subscription toothpicks.
text.zh: 你三十多岁的孩子“暂时”搬回家，带着一只收容所领养的狗、三盆植物，和一个订阅制牙签的创业点子。

text.en: Let them stay. Post house rules on a laminated card.
text.zh: 让他们住下。把家规塑封贴在墙上。

text.en: Set a move-out date. Be the loving landlord nobody asked for.
text.zh: 定个搬出日期。当个没人要的慈爱房东。

text.en: A friend dares you to sign up for a half-marathon. Your knees demand to speak to a manager.
text.zh: 朋友激你报名半程马拉松。你的膝盖要求见经理。

text.en: Train for it. Finish last, wearing your medal like a hero.
text.zh: 认真训练。最后一名冲线，把奖牌戴得像英雄。

text.en: Volunteer at the water station. Cheering counts as cardio.
text.zh: 去补给站当志愿者。喊加油也算有氧。

text.en: You learn a foreign language for a dream trip. After three months, you can order soup and apologize. That's it.
text.zh: 你为了梦想之旅学一门外语。三个月后，你会点汤，也会道歉。就这样。

text.en: Go anyway. Order soup with confidence and apologize to everyone.
text.zh: 照样出发。自信地点汤，并向每个人道歉。

text.en: Stay home and cook the soup yourself. The trip lives in your imagination.
text.zh: 留在家自己煮汤。旅行活在想象里。

text.en: You've said 'what?' so often that your family made it your nickname. A hearing test suggests a tiny device with big opinions.
text.zh: 你太常说“啊？”了，家人干脆把它当成你的外号。听力检查建议你戴一个意见很多的小装置。

text.en: Get hearing aids. Discover the family group chat was never that quiet.
text.zh: 配助听器。发现家族群原来从来没那么安静。

text.en: Keep nodding and smiling. Accidentally agree to host the next holiday.
text.zh: 继续点头微笑。结果不小心答应了主办下一次节日聚会。

text.en: A travel agent offers a 'once-in-a-lifetime' 40-day cruise. The brochure has one photo of a buffet and three of a life jacket.
text.zh: 旅行社推销“一生一次”的 40 天邮轮。宣传册里有一张自助餐的照片，和三张救生衣的照片。

text.en: Book it. Pack sea-sickness pills and pure optimism.
text.zh: 订了。带上晕船药和满满的乐观。

text.en: Take a week-long scenic train ride instead. Views without sea legs.
text.zh: 改坐为期一周的观光火车。有风景，不晕船。

text.en: Your book club has split into two factions over whether the last novel's ending was 'brilliant' or 'a crime'. Snacks are being weaponized.
text.zh: 你的读书会因为上一本小说的结局是“神来之笔”还是“一场犯罪”，分裂成两派。点心正被当成武器。

text.en: Start your own club with better snacks.
text.zh: 自己另开一个读书会，点心更好。

text.en: Play peacemaker: propose a book nobody has read yet.
text.zh: 当和事佬：提议读一本没人看过的书。

text.en: Your tomatoes are outperforming your neighbor's. He has started leaving anonymous notes: 'Nice tomatoes. Shame if something happened to them.'
text.zh: 你的番茄长得比邻居的好。他开始留匿名纸条：“番茄不错。要是出点什么事就可惜了。”

text.en: Escalate: install a tiny fence and a very small security camera.
text.zh: 升级战局：装一道小围栏，再装一个迷你监控。

text.en: Deliver a basket of tomatoes. Defeat him with kindness.
text.zh: 送一篮番茄过去。用善意打败他。

text.en: A letter from the government congratulates you on nearly reaching 100. Enclosed is a form asking you to confirm you're still alive.
text.zh: 政府来信祝贺你即将满一百岁。信里附了一张表格，要你确认自己还活着。

text.en: Frame the letter and mail back the form with a smiley face.
text.zh: 把信装裱起来，并在表格上画个笑脸寄回去。

text.en: Ignore it and nap. Officially, you're 'under review'.
text.zh: 不理它，去睡午觉。官方记录上，你“审核中”。

text.en: Your birthday cake has so many candles that the fire department sends a polite email.
text.zh: 你的生日蛋糕上蜡烛多到消防队寄来一封礼貌的邮件。

text.en: Blow them out with the whole family. It's a team sport.
text.zh: 全家人一起吹。这是团体项目。

text.en: Use one candle shaped like your age. Efficiency is wisdom.
text.zh: 只插一根数字形状的蜡烛。效率就是智慧。

text.en: Your great-grandchild needs to interview you for a school project: 'What was it like before the internet?'
text.zh: 你的曾孙要为学校作业采访你：“互联网出现以前是什么样子？”

text.en: Tell the whole story, embellished with a few dinosaurs.
text.zh: 把整段故事讲完，还加了几只恐龙。

text.en: Hand over a box of old photos and take a nap.
text.zh: 交出一盒老照片，然后去睡午觉。

text.en: Your family sets up a video call with fourteen relatives. Nobody is muted, and someone's parrot is singing.
text.zh: 家人给你开了一场十四位亲戚的视频通话。没有人静音，还有人家的鹦鹉在唱歌。

text.en: Stay on and become the star of the chaos.
text.zh: 留在线上，成为这场混乱的主角。

text.en: Say the screen froze and take a nap.
text.zh: 说屏幕卡住了，然后去睡午觉。

text.en: Your family begs for your legendary recipe. You've kept it secret for seventy years.
text.zh: 家人苦苦哀求你传授那道传说中的菜谱。你已经保密七十年了。

text.en: Write it down. Change one ingredient to keep them guessing.
text.zh: 写下来，但偷偷改掉一样材料，让他们继续猜。

text.en: Keep it secret. The mystery is the seasoning.
text.zh: 继续保密。神秘感就是最好的调味料。

text.en: The town asks you to seal a time capsule to be opened in fifty years. You're the guest of honor. Everyone is politely doing the math.
text.zh: 小镇请你为一个五十年后才开启的时间胶囊封口。你是贵宾，每个人都在礼貌地心算。

text.en: Add a letter and your favorite hat. Plan to attend the opening.
text.zh: 放进一封信和你最爱的帽子。打算出席开启仪式。

text.en: Add one note: 'Buy low, sell high.' Nothing else.
text.zh: 只放一张字条：“低买高卖。”没别的了。

text.en: The park names a bench after you for 'outstanding longevity'. It is deeply uncomfortable.
text.zh: 公园以“杰出长寿”为由，用你的名字命名了一张长椅。它坐起来非常不舒服。

text.en: Sit on it daily and greet every stranger.
text.zh: 每天坐在上面，跟每个路人打招呼。

text.en: Demand a cushion. Longevity should come with back support.
text.zh: 要求加个坐垫。长寿应该附赠腰部支撑。

text.en: You realize you've outlived your entire 'someday' list. You start a new one titled 'Tomorrow, Maybe'.
text.zh: 你发现自己已经活得比整张“改天再说”清单还久。于是你新开了一张，标题是“明天，也许”。

text.en: Tackle it: ice cream for breakfast, a sunrise, and a handwritten note to an old friend.
text.zh: 逐项完成：早餐吃冰淇淋、看日出、给老朋友写一封手写信。

text.en: Nap first. The list has waited this long.
text.zh: 先睡一觉。清单都等这么久了。

text.en: A local paper asks you to write a weekly advice column. Your first tip: 'Drink water and be kind. Everything else is decoration.'
text.zh: 本地报社邀你写每周的建议专栏。你的第一条建议：“多喝水，对人好。其他都是装饰。”

text.en: Accept. Become the town oracle.
text.zh: 接下专栏，成为小镇的先知。

text.en: Decline politely. Wisdom is free at the kitchen table.
text.zh: 礼貌婉拒。智慧在厨房饭桌上就是免费的。

text.en: You've outlived most of your old friends. The neighborhood kids invite you to their game night.
text.zh: 你的老朋友大多已经先走一步。附近的孩子邀你参加他们的游戏之夜。

text.en: Join. Learn a card game whose rules were invented by a nine-year-old.
text.zh: 加入。学一种规则由九岁小孩发明的纸牌游戏。

text.en: Stay in with tea and your old records.
text.zh: 留在家，泡杯茶听老唱片。

text.en: You slip in the garden. The paramedic calls you 'the toughest person I've met today'.
text.zh: 你在花园里滑了一跤。急救员说你是“我今天见过最硬的人”。

text.en: Go to the clinic for a checkup and accept a sturdy cane.
text.zh: 去诊所做检查，并接受一根结实的手杖。

text.en: Insist on ice cream first, then the checkup.
text.zh: 坚持先吃冰淇淋，再做检查。

text.en: Every online form's birth-year menu starts too late for you.
text.zh: 每一份网上表格的出生年份下拉菜单，起点都晚得没你的份。

text.en: Ask the grandkids to fill it in. Delegation is wisdom.
text.zh: 让孙子代填。懂得授权就是智慧。

text.en: Write a strongly worded letter to the website. On paper.
text.zh: 给网站写一封措辞强烈的信。用纸写的。

text.en: A squirrel has decided you're its personal secretary. It leaves acorns on your windowsill with 'urgent' notes.
text.zh: 一只松鼠认定你是它的私人秘书。它在你的窗台上留下橡果和“紧急”字条。

text.en: Accept the job. Answer the acorn mail.
text.zh: 接下这份工作，回复橡果来信。

text.en: Resign politely. The squirrel goes on strike outside.
text.zh: 礼貌辞职。松鼠在窗外罢工。

text.en: Your favorite armchair has been replaced by a modern recliner with fourteen buttons. It talks.
text.zh: 你最爱的扶手椅被换成了一把有十四个按钮的新款躺椅。它会说话。

text.en: Learn all fourteen buttons. Become master of the chair.
text.zh: 学会全部十四个按钮，成为椅子的主人。

text.en: Keep the old chair. It remembers your shape.
text.zh: 留下旧椅子。它记得你的形状。

text.en: The care-home band asks what song you'd like. You say: 'the one from my wedding.' Nobody knows it, but everyone hums along.
text.zh: 养老院的乐队问你想听什么歌。你说：“我婚礼上的那首。”没人听过，但大家都跟着哼。

text.en: Sing it yourself. Every wrong note is a memory.
text.zh: 自己唱。每一个跑调都是一段回忆。

text.en: Hum along and let the band figure it out.
text.zh: 跟着哼，让乐队自己摸索。

text.en: Everyone expects you to go straight to college. You want a gap year 'to find yourself'. Your savings: $412 and a very confident backpack.
text.zh: 所有人都期待你直接上大学。你想休一年“间隔年”找自己。你的存款：412 美元，外加一个信心满满的背包。

text.en: Enroll in college. Find yourself in the cafeteria line.
text.zh: 去上大学。在食堂排队的队伍里找自己。

text.en: Take the gap year. Find yourself, hopefully near a beach.
text.zh: 休间隔年。希望能在海滩附近找到自己。

text.en: Your assigned dorm roommate collects taxidermy squirrels and has strong opinions about your sleep schedule.
text.zh: 系统分配给你的宿舍室友收集松鼠标本，而且对你的作息有强烈意见。

text.en: Stay. Negotiate a 'no squirrels after 10 p.m.' treaty.
text.zh: 留下来。谈判出一份“晚上十点后不准出现松鼠”的条约。

text.en: Pay extra for a single room. Peace has a price tag.
text.zh: 加钱换单人间。平静是有标价的。

text.en: You fail your driving test for the second time. The examiner writes 'confident, but wrong' on your report.
text.zh: 你的驾照考试第二次没过。考官在报告上写着：“很有自信，但是错的。”

text.en: Book a third test and take lessons from your grandma.
text.zh: 报名第三次考试，并跟奶奶学开车。

text.en: Go carless. Bike everywhere and call it 'sustainable'.
text.zh: 放弃开车。骑自行车到处跑，还美其名曰“可持续生活”。

text.en: A campus table offers a free T-shirt if you sign up for a credit card. The shirt is remarkably soft.
text.zh: 校园摊位说，办一张信用卡就送免费 T 恤。那件 T 恤软得惊人。

text.en: Sign up. Softness has no price (until the statement arrives).
text.zh: 办卡。柔软无价（直到账单寄来为止）。

text.en: Walk away. Your neck stays in the freezing weather.
text.zh: 转身离开。你的脖子继续暴露在寒风里。

text.en: Summer job options: lifeguard at a pool with a suspicious smell, or a giant mascot suit at a burger stand in July.
text.zh: 暑期工二选一：在气味可疑的游泳池当救生员，或者七月穿巨型吉祥物玩偶服在汉堡摊前发传单。

text.en: Wear the mascot suit. Sweat is a form of branding.
text.zh: 穿上玩偶服。汗水也是一种品牌经营。

text.en: Guard the pool. Nobody drowns, everybody sighs.
text.zh: 守护泳池。没有人溺水，只有人叹气。

text.en: Your parents set a midnight curfew for a legal adult. Their leverage: free laundry and pasta.
text.zh: 你的父母给一个法定成年人定了午夜门禁。他们的筹码：免费洗衣服，以及意面。

text.en: Follow it. Enjoy the pasta and fold your dignity neatly.
text.zh: 乖乖遵守。享用意面，并把尊严叠得整整齐齐。

text.en: Move into a shared flat above a noisy bakery.
text.zh: 搬进一间在吵闹面包店楼上的合租公寓。

text.en: Your first election: the ballot has 43 items, and you've read none of them. A stranger offers a 'cheat sheet'.
text.zh: 你的第一次投票：选票上有 43 个项目，你一个都没读过。一个陌生人递来“小抄”。

text.en: Read every item. Arrive late, but informed.
text.zh: 把每个项目都读完。迟到，但很有见识。

text.en: Decide the first three and skip the rest. Democracy is a marathon.
text.zh: 只决定前三项，其余跳过。民主是场马拉松。

text.en: You want a tattoo of your crush's name. You've known them for eleven days.
text.zh: 你想纹一个暗恋对象名字的纹身。你认识对方十一天了。

text.en: Get it. Commitment looks great on skin.
text.zh: 纹。承诺在皮肤上看起来很棒。

text.en: Get a tiny cactus instead. Prickly and low-maintenance.
text.zh: 改纹一株小仙人掌。带刺而且好养活。

text.en: The valedictorian loses their voice. You're asked to give the graduation speech: five minutes, three index cards.
text.zh: 毕业生代表突然失声，你被临时拉去致辞：五分钟、三张小卡片。

text.en: Wing it with jokes about the cafeteria.
text.zh: 即兴发挥，全是关于学校食堂的笑话。

text.en: Read the cards. They are somehow in the wrong order.
text.zh: 照着卡片念。卡片不知为何顺序全乱了。

text.en: The required textbook costs $280. It's a 'new edition' with two changed commas.
text.zh: 指定教材要价 280 美元。所谓“新版”只改了两个逗号。

text.en: Buy it new. Enjoy the smell of overpriced paper.
text.zh: 买全新的。闻着昂贵纸张的味道。

text.en: Share one copy with three strangers via a 'study group'.
text.zh: 跟三个陌生人组成“学习小组”，共用一本。

text.en: Your final essay is due at 9 a.m. It's 1 a.m. You have a title and a mug.
text.zh: 期末论文早上九点截止。现在凌晨一点。你只有一个标题和一个马克杯。

text.en: Pull an all-nighter. Coffee is a food group.
text.zh: 通宵赶工。咖啡也算一种食物类别。

text.en: Email the professor for an extension. Include three apologies.
text.zh: 写邮件向教授申请延期。附上三次道歉。

text.en: The club fair has 200 booths. One promises free snacks; another promises 'life-changing networking'.
text.zh: 社团招新有两百个摊位。有一个保证提供免费零食，另一个则保证“改变人生的人脉”。

text.en: Join the snack club. Learn about competitive origami.
text.zh: 加入零食社。顺便学会竞技折纸。

text.en: Join the networking club. Get a lanyard and a nervous handshake.
text.zh: 加入人脉社。领到一条挂绳和一次紧张的握手。

text.en: A study-abroad program offers six months in a beautiful city. You speak the language at 'polite hello' level. The flights cost a small fortune.
text.zh: 交换项目提供半年的美丽城市生活。你的当地语言只有“礼貌打招呼”的水平。机票贵得像一笔小财富。

text.en: Go. Order food by pointing.
text.zh: 出发。靠比划点餐。

text.en: Stay home. Watch travel videos with subtitles.
text.zh: 留在家。看带字幕的旅游视频。

text.en: Your food budget is $40 a week. Your stomach has filed a formal complaint.
text.zh: 你每周的伙食预算是 40 美元。你的胃已经提出了正式申诉。

text.en: Meal-prep rice and beans for seven days. Become a spreadsheet.
text.zh: 一周七天都吃备餐的米饭和豆子。人生变成一张表格。

text.en: Order takeout twice. Live a little.
text.zh: 点两次外卖。偶尔也要活一下。

text.en: You've been 'talking' to someone for three months. Nobody has said 'together'. Your friends run a group chat about it.
text.zh: 你跟某人“聊”了三个月，没有人说过“在一起”这三个字。你的朋友们还为此建了个群。

text.en: Ask directly. Brace for impact.
text.zh: 直接问清楚。做好承受冲击的准备。

text.en: Keep it vague and let the group chat speculate.
text.zh: 保持暧昧，让群里自行推测。

text.en: The dorm fire alarm goes off at 3 a.m. because someone burned popcorn. Again.
text.zh: 宿舍消防警报在凌晨三点响起，原因又是有人烧焦了爆米花。

text.en: Evacuate in pajamas and become a campus meme.
text.zh: 穿着睡衣疏散，顺便成为校园表情包。

text.en: Volunteer as dorm safety rep. Get a stipend and a whistle.
text.zh: 自愿当宿舍安全员。领到津贴和一个哨子。

text.en: A campus job opens: night shift at the library desk. Duties include shushing people and guarding the good chairs.
text.zh: 校园兼职缺人：图书馆夜班前台。工作内容是让人小声点，以及守护好座位。

text.en: Take it. Become a legend of the quiet.
text.zh: 接下。成为安静界的传奇。

text.en: Decline. Sell your class notes online instead.
text.zh: 婉拒。改把上课笔记放到网上卖。

text.en: Your unpaid internship's main task: making coffee for twelve people, none of whom know your name.
text.zh: 你的无薪实习主要工作：给十二个人泡咖啡，其中没有一个人知道你叫什么。

text.en: Stay. Learn every coffee order and every secret.
text.zh: 留下。记住每个人的咖啡口味和每一个秘密。

setJob.zh: 实习生（无薪，咖啡因超标）

text.en: Quit and freelance designing logos for friends.
text.zh: 辞职，改替朋友接单设计 logo。

text.en: You discover your credit score is 'not enough data'. The bank suggests you 'build history'.
text.zh: 你发现自己的信用评分是“数据不足”。银行建议你“积累记录”。

text.en: Open a starter card and pay it on time like a monk.
text.zh: 办张入门信用卡，并像僧侣一样准时还款。

text.en: Ignore it. Cash is king (and lonely).
text.zh: 不理它。现金为王（而且孤单）。

text.en: Your thesis topic: 'The Sociology of Naps'. Your advisor sighs like a broken accordion.
text.zh: 你的论文题目：《午睡社会学》。指导教授叹气的声音像一台坏掉的手风琴。

text.en: Commit. Nap-based fieldwork begins.
text.zh: 坚持到底。以午睡为主的田野调查正式开始。

text.en: Switch to a safe topic about supply chains.
text.zh: 改成一个安全的供应链题目。

text.en: You furnish your first apartment from the curb: a couch with a mysterious stain and a lamp with an attitude.
text.zh: 你的第一间公寓全靠路边捡来的家具布置：一张有神秘污渍的沙发，和一盏很有个性的台灯。

text.en: Take everything. Cover the stain with a blanket 'for style'.
text.zh: 全部搬回家。用毯子盖住污渍，美其名曰“风格”。

text.en: Buy flat-pack furniture and lose two weekends to a diagram.
text.zh: 买组装家具，两个周末都输给了一张说明图。

text.en: A weekend hackathon offers $500 for the best idea. Yours: an app that reminds you to drink water by insulting you.
text.zh: 周末黑客松为最佳点子提供 500 美元奖金。你的点子：一个用羞辱来提醒你喝水的 app。

text.en: Pitch it. Bring a mascot.
text.zh: 上台路演。还带了一个吉祥物。

text.en: Skip it and sleep for fourteen hours.
text.zh: 跳过，睡上十四个小时。

text.en: At the holiday table, a relative asks, 'So what's your plan?' Your plan is 'lunch'.
text.zh: 过年饭桌上，亲戚问：“所以你接下来什么打算？”你的打算是“午饭”。

text.en: Say 'entrepreneur' and change the subject to pie.
text.zh: 回答“创业者”，然后把话题转到派上。

text.en: Be honest: 'lunch, then figure it out.' Receive an hour of advice and some cash.
text.zh: 老实说：“先吃午饭，再慢慢想。”换来一小时的建议和一些零花钱。

text.en: You break up with someone you share a lease with. The houseplant is in both names.
text.zh: 你和同居的伴侣分手了。那盆绿植上写着你们两个人的名字。

text.en: Share custody of the plant. Send weekly growth updates.
text.zh: 共同监护那盆植物。每周发送生长报告。

setRelationship.zh: 单身（与前任共同养植物）

text.en: Give them the plant. Keep the good pan.
text.zh: 把植物给对方，自己留下好用的平底锅。

text.en: A student loan letter arrives with 'Congratulations!' in the header. It is not congratulations.
text.zh: 助学贷款通知信寄到，标题写着“恭喜！”这并不是恭喜。

text.en: Set up a payment plan and a spreadsheet named 'Doom'.
text.zh: 设定还款计划，并建一份叫“末日”的表格。

text.en: Deliver groceries on the side to pay it off faster.
text.zh: 兼职送生鲜外卖，想更快还清。

text.en: You enroll in the legendary philosophy elective whose syllabus opens with: 'Most of you will fail. That is the point.' By week two, half the class has vanished.
text.zh: 你选了那门传说中“全班必挂”的哲学课。教学大纲第一页写着：“你们大多数人会挂科，这正是本课的意义。”才第二周，班上就跑了一半。

text.en: Stay. Read Kant at 2 a.m. and call it 'personal growth.'
text.zh: 留下。凌晨两点啃康德，还管这叫“个人成长”。

text.en: Drop the course and pay the late-withdrawal fee. Peace of mind has a processing charge.
text.zh: 退课，交一笔逾期退课费。心安是要收手续费的。

text.en: Your final group project has four teammates, and all four have vanished. The group chat is just you, typing into the void.
text.zh: 期末小组作业的四个组员全部人间蒸发。群聊里只剩你一个人，对着虚空打字。

text.en: Do it all yourself. Put four names on the cover page anyway.
text.zh: 全部自己搞定。封面上照样署四个人的名字。

text.en: Name and shame them in the peer-evaluation form. Watch the dead group chat resurrect.
text.zh: 在组内互评表上实名举报。看着死寂的群聊瞬间“诈尸”。

text.en: Orientation-camp icebreaker: hug a stranger, introduce yourself in rhyme, then lead a group dance to a song nobody knows. Someone brought a tambourine.
text.zh: 迎新营的破冰游戏：拥抱一个陌生人，用押韵的方式自我介绍，再带全组跳一支没人听过的舞。有人还带了铃鼓。

text.en: Commit fully. Rhyme like your GPA depends on it.
text.zh: 彻底放开。押韵押得像绩点全靠它。

text.en: Fake a stomachache and hide in the bathroom for forty minutes.
text.zh: 假装肚子疼，在厕所躲四十分钟。

text.en: An anonymous scholarship offers you $4,000 a semester. The only condition: write the sponsor a thank-you letter every week. They never reply. Until week six.
text.zh: 一笔来历不明的匿名奖学金，每学期 4000 美元。唯一的条件：每周给赞助人写一封感谢信。对方从不回信——直到第六周。

text.en: Accept. Write 'Dear Benefactor' every Sunday, with growing unease.
text.zh: 接受。每周日写“亲爱的恩人”，越写越发毛。

text.en: Decline politely and take extra shifts at the campus diner.
text.zh: 礼貌拒绝，去食堂多打几份工。

text.en: The thermos you use to 'reserve' your library seat has been stolen. The seat is occupied. The betrayal is double.
text.zh: 你放在图书馆座位上占座的保温杯被偷了。座位被别人占了，杯子也不知所踪。背叛是双重的。

text.en: Post a 'WANTED: Thermos Thief' poster. It becomes campus legend.
text.zh: 贴出“通缉保温杯窃贼”海报。它成了校园传说。

text.en: Buy a new $45 thermos and a bike lock to chain it to the chair.
text.zh: 买个 45 美元的新保温杯，再配把车锁把它锁在椅子上。

text.en: Your thesis draft returns with a 48% similarity score. The reason: you quoted every relevant statute in full. The software can't tell the law from plagiarism.
text.zh: 你的论文初稿查重率高达 48%。原因是你把所有相关法规条文一字不落地引了个遍。查重软件分不清法律和抄袭。

text.en: Paraphrase every statute yourself. Lawyers everywhere weep.
text.zh: 把每一条法规逐条改写。全世界的法律人都在为你落泪。

text.en: Pay $300 for a 'professional academic editing service' and hope.
text.zh: 花 300 美元请“专业学术润色服务”，然后祈祷。

text.en: At your trendy café job, a customer demands latte art of 'a cat with sad eyes.' The line behind them keeps growing.
text.zh: 你在网红咖啡店兼职当咖啡师，一位顾客要求你在拿铁上拉花“画出一只眼神悲伤的猫”。身后的队伍越排越长。

text.en: Try it. The result looks like a haunted potato. The customer films it.
text.zh: 硬着头皮画。成品像一颗闹鬼的土豆。顾客拍成了视频。

text.en: Refuse: 'We only do hearts.' The customer leaves a one-star review.
text.zh: 拒绝：“我们只做爱心。”顾客随手给了个一星差评。

text.en: You're hired as a 'spontaneous audience member' at an expo for $120 a day. The organizer wants you to stand and yell 'This is mind-blowing!' at a smart trash can launch.
text.zh: 你被雇去展会当“自发观众”，日薪 120 美元。主办方要你在智能垃圾桶发布会上站起来大喊：“太震撼了！”

text.en: Yell it with tears in your eyes. Method acting pays.
text.zh: 含泪大喊。演技也是生产力。

text.en: Only clap, stay silent. They dock half your pay and glare at you all day.
text.zh: 只鼓掌，不喊话。主办方扣了你一半工资，还全程盯着你。

text.en: On your first day at your first full-time job, the veteran assigned to train you hands in their resignation by lunch. 'Good luck,' they say. 'Also, don't trust the printer.'
text.zh: 第一份正职入职第一天，负责带你的老员工中午前就递了辞呈，临走留下一句：“祝你好运。另外，别相信打印机。”

text.en: Inherit the chaos. Learn everything by trial and error.
text.zh: 接手烂摊子。靠试错学会所有事。

text.en: Grab the veteran's contacts and quietly start job hunting.
text.zh: 要来老员工的联系方式，悄悄开始找下家。

text.en: Your side gig walking a professor's Labrador goes smoothly, until the dog spots a duck and drags you straight into the campus lake.
text.zh: 你帮教授遛拉布拉多的兼职一直挺顺，直到那条狗看见一只鸭子，把你一路拖进了校园人工湖。

text.en: Dive in after the dog. Your phone drowns; the professor calls you 'a hero.'
text.zh: 跳进去追狗。手机阵亡，教授却称你为“英雄”。

text.en: Drop the leash and film from the shore. The dog swims out fine. Your gig doesn't.
text.zh: 松开牵引绳，站在岸边拍视频。狗自己游回来了，你的兼职却没了。

text.en: You're a part-time 'ghost' NPC in an escape room. A customer, terrified by your jump scare, punches you square in the eye.
text.zh: 你在密室逃脱里兼职扮演鬼怪 NPC。一位顾客被你吓破了胆，一拳正中你的眼眶。

text.en: Keep working with an ice pack. The show must go on; the eye must swell.
text.zh: 敷着冰袋继续上班。演出不能停，眼睛可以肿。

text.en: Take three days off. The manager docks your wages.
text.zh: 请三天假养伤。老板顺手扣了你的工资。

text.en: You sign a year-long lease, then discover the neighbors are a suona band, a piercingly loud traditional horn ensemble, that rehearses at 11 p.m. every night.
text.zh: 刚跟房东签完一年租约，你就发现隔壁住着一支唢呐乐队，每晚十一点准时排练。

text.en: Break the lease and forfeit the deposit. Silence costs $1,500.
text.zh: 毁约搬走，押金泡汤。安静的价格是 1500 美元。

text.en: Stay. Buy earplugs and slowly memorize their entire repertoire.
text.zh: 留下。买耳塞，还慢慢把整套曲目背了下来。

text.en: To save money, you buy a bulk crate of near-expiry instant noodles. After a week, your face has developed an oil-slick shine.
text.zh: 为了省钱，你囤了一整箱临期泡面。吃了一周，你的脸开始泛出油光，堪比刚出锅的锅贴。

text.en: Finish the crate. Frugality has a face, and it's shiny.
text.zh: 把整箱吃完。省钱是有脸的，而且很油。

text.en: Toss the rest and buy real vegetables. Your wallet quietly sobs.
text.zh: 把剩下的扔掉，去买真正的蔬菜。钱包默默流泪。

text.en: You buy a cheap second-hand washing machine online. During the spin cycle, it starts to 'walk' across the living room like it's trying to escape.
text.zh: 你在网上淘了台便宜的二手洗衣机。一到脱水，它就在客厅里疯狂“散步”，像是要越狱。

text.en: Wedge it with textbooks and stand guard. Laundry day is now a wrestling match.
text.zh: 拿教材把它卡住，全程守着。洗衣日变成了摔跤日。

text.en: Resell it at a loss and use the laundromat. Coins and dignity.
text.zh: 亏本转卖，改去自助洗衣店。攒硬币，也攒尊严。

text.en: A friend you've known for two weeks wants you to set up 'Couples Pay,' a shared-spending feature, 'just for the discounts.' They've mentioned the discounts three times.
text.zh: 一个才认识两周的朋友拉你开通“亲密付”，说“就为了那点优惠”。对方把“优惠”两个字强调了三遍。

text.en: Say yes. Save a little; expose your spending habits.
text.zh: 答应。省了点钱，也暴露了你的消费习惯。

text.en: Decline. Keep your privacy, lose the discounts.
text.zh: 拒绝。保住隐私，错过优惠。

text.en: Your first big supermarket run goes off the rails. You leave with enough cleaning liquid to last three years, plus a 'buy one, get one free' pack of toilet brushes.
text.zh: 第一次逛大型超市，你彻底失控。结账才发现，买了够用三年的清洁剂，外加一组“买一送一”的马桶刷。

text.en: Keep it all. Your apartment now smells like pine forest and regret.
text.zh: 全留下。你家现在弥漫着松木香和后悔。

text.en: Return half. Argue with customer service over a receipt for an hour, but at least you can walk through the apartment again.
text.zh: 退掉一半。跟客服为一张小票争论一小时，但家里终于能下脚了。

text.en: Your crush invites you to a 'study date.' Then they pull out a full set of advanced calculus problems: 'You're so smart. Could you explain these?'
text.zh: 暗恋对象约你去自习，结果对方掏出一整套高等数学习题：“你这么聪明，能给我讲讲吗？”

text.en: Bluff. Cram video lectures at 2 a.m. and explain with total confidence.
text.zh: 硬撑。半夜狂刷网课，再自信满满地讲。

text.en: Confess you're clueless too. Suggest solving them together over bubble tea.
text.zh: 坦白你也不会。提议边喝奶茶边一起做。

text.en: At a friend's party, Truth or Dare lands on you: 'What's your most embarrassing elementary-school moment?' Everyone leans in. Someone starts recording.
text.zh: 朋友聚会玩真心话大冒险，你抽中了：“说出你小学时最尴尬的黑历史。”所有人都凑了过来，还有人已经开始录像。

text.en: Confess: you called the teacher 'Mom' in front of the whole class, then cried.
text.zh: 老实交代：你在全班面前管老师叫了“妈”，然后哭了。

text.en: Take the penalty instead: a cup of soy sauce, cola and pickle juice.
text.zh: 选择接受惩罚：一杯酱油、可乐和泡菜汁的混合特饮。

text.en: On your first date, you both order the 'extra-hot' hotpot. Neither wants to lose face. You both chug ice water and insist it's 'refreshing.'
text.zh: 第一次约会，你们都点了“特辣”火锅。谁也不想丢面子，两个人一边狂灌冰水，一边硬说“这就叫爽”。

text.en: Push through. Sweat, tears, and a shared queue for the bathroom.
text.zh: 硬扛到底。汗水、泪水，外加一起排队上厕所的默契。

text.en: Admit defeat and order the mild broth. Dignity down, digestion up.
text.zh: 认输，改点清汤锅。尊严下降，肠胃回升。

text.en: A dating app matches you with someone funny, kind, and unnervingly good at memes. At the first meet-up you realize: they're your class advisor, the one who signs your attendance sheets.
text.zh: 社交软件给你匹配了一个风趣、温柔、表情包水平高得吓人的人。第一次见面你才发现：对方是你们班的辅导员，就是每周给你签考勤表的那位。

text.en: Keep going, 'professionally.' Meet every Friday under the label 'advising session.'
text.zh: 继续聊，“职业化”一点。每周五以“辅导谈话”的名义见面。

text.en: Unmatch and pretend nothing happened. Awkward eye contact at every meeting, but at least you sleep.
text.zh: 取消匹配，假装什么都没发生。之后每次开会都尴尬对视，但至少睡得着觉。

text.en: The delivery app pings: 'Storm surge! 2x pay!' Outside, the sky looks like it's filing for divorce from the city.
text.zh: 外卖 App 弹窗：“暴雨加价，收入翻倍！”窗外的天空阴得像在跟这座城市办离婚手续。

text.en: Ride out. Double pay is a hell of a lullaby for your wet socks.
text.zh: 出门送。双倍单价，是对湿透的袜子最好的安慰。

text.en: Stay home with instant noodles and a dry conscience.
text.zh: 宅家泡面，保住干爽的良心。

text.en: The 'interview' turns out to be a three-hour slideshow. The offer is instant, if you buy a $300 'Success Starter Kit'. It includes a lanyard.
text.zh: 这场“面试”其实是三小时的 PPT 洗脑。当场发 offer，前提是买一套 300 块的“成功入门礼包”。礼包里有一条挂绳。

text.en: Buy the kit. Congratulations, you're now 'Regional Director' of nothing.
text.zh: 买。恭喜，你现在是“某片空气区域总监”。

text.en: Walk out mid-slide. Dignity is free, but so is the bus fare you now owe yourself.
text.zh: PPT 放到一半起身就走。尊严不要钱，但回程车费得自己掏。

text.en: Your 'one-day trial' is now on day six. HR says 'the offer is being finalized.' The offer has apparently been finalized since Tuesday, in a parallel universe.
text.zh: 说好的“一天试岗”，今天是第六天。HR 说“offer 正在走流程”。这个流程大概在平行宇宙里已经走了整整一周。

text.en: Keep showing up. Free labor is just an investment with no return date.
text.zh: 继续去。免费劳动，就是一笔没有到期日的投资。

text.en: Demand a paid day rate or leave. Your rent doesn't accept exposure.
text.zh: 要求结日薪，不给就走。房东不收“曝光度”。

text.en: You discover your roommate has been reselling your shared Wi-Fi to the upstairs neighbor for $8 a month. The router is in your name.
text.zh: 你发现室友一直把合租的 Wi-Fi 以每月 8 块的价格转卖给楼上邻居。路由器还登记在你名下。

text.en: Demand a cut and become a silent partner in the ISP business.
text.zh: 要求分成，正式成为这家“地下运营商”的沉默股东。

text.en: Change the password and give a speech about 'boundaries'.
text.zh: 改密码，顺便发表一通关于“边界感”的演讲。

text.en: The school's AI detector says your fully human, sleep-deprived essay is 98% machine-written. You are insulted and also slightly flattered.
text.zh: 学校的 AI 检测器判定你熬夜写的纯人工论文“98% 为机器生成”。你既被冒犯，又有点被夸到。

text.en: File a formal appeal with drafts and timestamps. Bureaucracy vs. your remaining will to live.
text.zh: 提交正式申诉，附上草稿和时间戳。官僚系统对决你所剩无几的求生欲。

text.en: Rewrite it worse on purpose so it 'sounds more human'.
text.zh: 故意改得更烂，好显得“更像人写的”。

text.en: Your landlord deducts $600 from your deposit for 'emotional wear on the walls.' You lived there quietly. The walls were already crying when you moved in.
text.zh: 房东从押金里扣了 600 块，理由是“墙面情感损耗”。你住得安安静静，搬进来时那面墙自己就已经在哭了。

text.en: Take them to small claims court. Spend four Saturdays fighting for $600.
text.zh: 去小额法庭告房东。花四个周六，只为拿回 600 块。

text.en: Let it go. Rage is expensive, but so is a court date.
text.zh: 算了。愤怒很贵，出庭也不便宜。

text.en: On the first date, your date proposes splitting the bill by item, including your tap water. The mood is now a tax return.
text.zh: 第一次约会，对方提议按菜品 AA，连你那杯白开水也单算。气氛瞬间变成报税现场。

text.en: Split it down to the cent. Romance dies, but your wallet lives.
text.zh: 精确到分地 AA。浪漫死了，钱包活了。

text.en: Pay the whole thing with a smile. Chivalry is a subscription service.
text.zh: 笑着全买单。体面是一种订阅服务。

text.en: The company holds a 'voluntary' Saturday karaoke night. Attendance is tracked. The CEO has chosen the song. It's a duet with you.
text.zh: 公司组织“自愿参加”的周六 K 歌夜，出勤有记录。老板点了歌，是和你的对唱。

text.en: Sing your heart out. Nothing says 'team player' like a cracked high note.
text.zh: 含泪开嗓。破音的高音，是最有说服力的团队精神。

text.en: Fake a stomachache. You are now labeled 'not a culture fit'.
text.zh: 装肚子疼溜了。你被贴上了“不太合群”的标签。

text.en: A lab pays $500 for a two-week clinical trial. The side effects list ends with 'and other unknown sensations.'
text.zh: 某实验室开价 500 块，招募两周药物试验志愿者。副作用清单的最后一行写着：“以及其他未知的体验”。

text.en: Sign up. Your body is now a part-time job.
text.zh: 报名。你的身体从此成了一份兼职。

text.en: Skip it. Ramen for another week is the cheaper side effect.
text.zh: 不去。再吃一周泡面，副作用小多了。

text.en: Your ex still holds your $700 speaker and favorite hoodie 'hostage'. They text: 'Come get them. We can talk.' You suspect it's a trap with a sweater.
text.zh: 前任还扣着你 700 块的音箱和最爱的卫衣当“人质”，发消息：“来拿吧，顺便聊聊。”你怀疑这是个带毛衣的陷阱。

text.en: Go get them. Retrieve the speaker, absorb the emotional shrapnel.
text.zh: 亲自去取。拿回音箱，顺带吃一身情感碎片。

text.en: Abandon the speaker. Your peace of mind costs exactly $700.
text.zh: 放弃音箱。内心的平静，标价 700 块。

text.en: The student club needs a new president: unpaid, 60 hours a week, 'looks amazing on a resume.' The last president is in witness protection.
text.zh: 学生社团缺一个新社长：无薪，每周 60 小时，“简历上会非常漂亮”。上一任社长目前疑似进入了证人保护计划。

text.en: Accept. You now run a budget of $200 and a crisis of $200,000 in scale.
text.zh: 接下。你现在掌管 200 块预算，和价值 20 万的精神危机。

text.en: Decline. Your resume stays plain, your weekends stay yours.
text.zh: 拒绝。简历依旧朴素，周末依旧属于你。

text.en: Someone keeps eating your labeled leftovers. The label says 'DO NOT EAT (YES, YOU)'. The label is also now missing.
text.zh: 总有人偷吃你贴了标签的剩菜。标签上写着“禁止食用（说的就是你）”。现在连标签也被吃了。

text.en: Buy a mini fridge with a lock. Security is expensive, and so is lasagna.
text.zh: 买台带锁的小冰箱。安保很贵，千层面也是。

text.en: Leave a passive-aggressive note and cook double. Community is a hostage situation.
text.zh: 留张阴阳怪气的便条，顺手多做一份。社区精神，本质上就是被勒索。

text.en: Your parents ask, in front of every relative on the family video call, 'So how much do you actually make?' The relatives lean into their cameras like vultures with Wi-Fi.
text.zh: 全家视频聊天，父母当着所有亲戚的面问：“你现在到底一个月挣多少？”亲戚们齐刷刷凑近镜头，像一群有 Wi-Fi 的秃鹫。

text.en: Exaggerate. Now everyone expects gifts, and so do the relatives' relatives.
text.zh: 往高了说。现在人人都盼着你送礼，连亲戚的亲戚也开始排队。

text.en: Tell the truth. Silence, then your parent secretly transfers you $200.
text.zh: 说实话。全场沉默，然后父母偷偷给你转了 200 块。

text.en: You're one win away from Diamond rank. It's 3 a.m., and your teammates are 'basically pros' who also have jobs tomorrow.
text.zh: 你离钻石段位只差一场胜利。现在是凌晨三点，队友们是“准职业选手”，明天大概也都还要上班。

text.en: Queue again. Diamond is forever; your eyebags are merely a temporary DLC.
text.zh: 再排一局。钻石是永恒的，黑眼圈只是限时 DLC。

text.en: Log off and sleep. Your team blacklists you before you brush your teeth.
text.zh: 退游戏睡觉。队友在你刷牙前就把你拉黑了。

text.en: After three interview rounds and two months of silence, HR emails: 'We'd love to move forward!' The salary is 20% lower than the posting. 'Market conditions.'
text.zh: 三轮面试后，对方音信全无两个月。突然 HR 来信：“我们很想推进下一步！”薪资比招聘启事低了 20%。理由：“市场环境变化”。

text.en: Accept. A smaller paycheck still beats a bigger rejection.
text.zh: 接受。缩水的工资，也好过放大的拒信。

text.en: Decline and keep job hunting. Your dignity has never been this unemployed.
text.zh: 拒绝，继续投简历。你的尊严从没这么“待业”过。

text.en: HR puts you on a 'Performance Improvement Plan,' described as 'an exciting opportunity to grow.' The growth chart is a downward staircase.
text.zh: HR 把你放进“绩效改进计划”，并称之为“一次令人兴奋的成长机会”。成长曲线看起来是一道往下的楼梯。

text.en: Grind through it. Survive on caffeine and spite until the plan expires.
text.zh: 硬扛到底。靠咖啡因和怨气续命，直到计划过期。

text.en: Update your resume at your desk. Quit with a two-week gap and one loud sigh.
text.zh: 在工位上更新简历，带着两周空窗期和一声长叹辞职。

text.en: After layoffs, you 'survived.' Your reward: the workload of three people and a company hoodie that says 'Resilience.'
text.zh: 公司裁员后，你“幸存”了。奖励是三个人的工作量，外加一件印着“韧性”的文化衫。

text.en: Take the extra work for a 5% raise. Survivors get crumbs, and the crumbs are unsalted.
text.zh: 接下额外工作，换 5% 的涨薪。幸存者只配吃面包屑，还是没放盐的。

text.en: Do exactly your old job. Wait quietly on the next layoff list.
text.zh: 只做原本的工作。安静等着下一轮裁员名单。

text.en: You're promoted to 'Senior Vice Assistant to the Assistant Director.' Salary change: none. Business cards: gorgeous.
text.zh: 你被提拔为“助理总监高级副助理”。工资变化：无。名片：非常漂亮。

text.en: Accept the title. LinkedIn will love you, your landlord won't.
text.zh: 收下头衔。领英会爱你，房东不会。

text.en: Ask for the raise instead. The title is politely 'reconsidered.'
text.zh: 要求涨薪，不要头衔。头衔被“礼貌地重新考虑”了。

text.en: Your fixed mortgage rate expires. The bank's new offer is written in a font designed to be unreadable.
text.zh: 你的固定房贷利率到期了。银行的新方案，用的是一种专门设计得让人看不清的字体。

text.en: Refinance. Pay fees now to hate your future less.
text.zh: 转贷。现在付手续费，为的是少恨未来一点。

text.en: Stay put and eat the higher payment. Paperwork is a form of violence.
text.zh: 不动，硬吃高月供。文书工作是一种暴力。

text.en: Your aunt sets you up with 'a very stable person in the civil service.' Their profile arrives as a 14-slide PowerPoint, including an appendix on hobbies.
text.zh: 姑姑给你介绍了一位“非常稳定的体制内对象”。资料是 14 页的 PPT，附录还专门介绍了兴趣爱好。

text.en: Go on the date. The appendix was, honestly, kind of charming.
text.zh: 去见一面。说真的，那个附录还有点可爱。

text.en: Politely refuse. Your aunt now forwards you articles about 'the biology of loneliness.'
text.zh: 礼貌拒绝。姑姑现在开始转发你《论孤独的生物学》。

text.en: Your annual checkup report arrives with 11 red arrows pointing up. The doctor says, 'Everything is technically manageable.' 'Technically' is doing a lot of work.
text.zh: 年度体检报告出来了，共 11 个向上的红箭头。医生说：“理论上一切都可以控制。”“理论上”这三个字扛了太多。

text.en: Overhaul your lifestyle: gym, salads, and a scale you fear.
text.zh: 全面改造生活：健身房、沙拉，和一台让你害怕的体重秤。

text.en: Laminate the report and use it as a coaster. Ignorance is a deductible.
text.zh: 把报告塑封成杯垫。无知，是一笔可抵扣的开支。

text.en: A guru promises '$10k/month with AI dropshipping.' The course costs $2,000. Success stories are all filmed in the same rented Lamborghini.
text.zh: 某大师承诺“AI 无货源，月入过万”。课程只要 2000 块。所有成功案例，都是在同一辆租来的兰博基尼里拍的。

text.en: Buy the course. Hope is a premium product.
text.zh: 买课。希望是一件高端商品。

text.en: Take a real side gig: weekend tutoring. Less glam, more actual money.
text.zh: 老老实实接份副业：周末带课。不够酷，但真有钱。

text.en: Management announces five mandatory office days. Commute: two hours each way. Justification: 'collaboration synergy.' The synergy is a broken elevator.
text.zh: 公司宣布每周五天强制到岗，单程通勤两小时，理由是“协作协同效应”。所谓协同，其实是一部坏掉的电梯。

text.en: Comply. Your face becomes visible; your soul does not.
text.zh: 服从。你的脸被看见了，灵魂却没有。

text.en: Work from home 'discreetly.' A green status dot becomes your religion.
text.zh: 偷偷居家办公。那个绿色在线小圆点成了你的信仰。
