text.en: Your partner proposes a shared spreadsheet where every purchase is categorized. 'Transparency,' they say. Your $340 monthly coffee habit starts sweating.
text.zh: 另一半提议建一个共享表格，每一笔消费都要分类。“这叫透明。”对方说。你每月 340 块的咖啡开销开始冒冷汗。

text.en: Agree. Your savings grow; your joy gets a budget cap.
text.zh: 同意。存款上涨，快乐被设了预算上限。

text.en: Keep finances separate and argue about it once a week. Freedom isn't free.
text.zh: 坚持各管各的钱，每周吵一次。自由是有价格的。

text.en: Your coworkers' lottery pool wins $50,000. You skipped the $5 chip-in. They offer you a $1,000 'pity share' and a look you'll remember forever.
text.zh: 同事们合买的彩票中奖 5 万块。你没交那 5 块钱。他们给你一份 1000 块的“同情分红”，外加一个你会记一辈子的眼神。

text.en: Accept the pity share. Money doesn't care how you got it.
text.zh: 收下同情分红。钱不在乎它是怎么到手的。

text.en: Decline and buy everyone coffee for a month. Dignity has a subscription fee.
text.zh: 拒绝，并请大家喝一个月咖啡。尊严是要付订阅费的。

text.en: Your landlord is selling the apartment and gives you 60 days to decide: buy it at a 'friendly price' or find another home. 'Friendly' means only slightly hostile.
text.zh: 房东要卖房，给你 60 天决定：买下来（“友情价”），或者另找住处。所谓“友情”，意思是稍微没那么敌对。

text.en: Buy it. Congratulations on becoming a 30-year customer of the bank.
text.zh: 买下。恭喜你，成为银行长达三十年的忠实客户。

text.en: Move again. Boxes, tape, and the bill for a truck named 'Regret.'
text.zh: 再搬一次家。纸箱、胶带，和一辆名叫“后悔”的货车账单。

text.en: An old friend asks to borrow $3,000 'just for two weeks.' This is the third time they've said 'two weeks.' The first two lasted a year.
text.zh: 老友又来借 3000 块，说“就两周”。这已经是第三次说“两周”了。前两次的“两周”，各自持续了一年。

text.en: Lend it. Friendship is an unsecured loan with interest paid in guilt.
text.zh: 借给对方。友情，是一笔以愧疚计息的无抵押贷款。

text.en: Refuse. They post a vague, poetic story about 'loyalty' by midnight.
text.zh: 拒绝。对方午夜前发了条含沙射影的“论忠诚”动态。

text.en: A coworker films you sighing at the office printer. The clip goes viral as 'Tired Adult.' Millions of strangers now feel deeply seen by your exhaustion.
text.zh: 有同事拍下你对着打印机叹气的视频，爆火成“疲惫成年人”。几百万陌生人，因为你的疲惫而深深感到被理解。

text.en: Monetize it. Brand deals, and HR schedules a 'quick chat.'
text.zh: 趁热变现。品牌合作找上门，HR 也约你“简单聊聊”。

text.en: Ask for a takedown. You hire a lawyer to defend a sigh.
text.zh: 要求下架。你请了律师，去为一声叹气辩护。

text.en: Your smartwatch buzzes mid-pitch: 'Irregular heartbeat detected.' The client is signing in five minutes. Your heart is also negotiating.
text.zh: 你在做提案时，智能手表震了：“检测到心率异常。”客户五分钟后就要签约。你的心脏也在同时谈判。

text.en: Rush to the ER. Diagnosis: too much coffee and too little you.
text.zh: 冲去急诊。诊断：咖啡太多，自己太少。

text.en: Ignore it and close the deal. The watch can't sign contracts.
text.zh: 无视警报，继续签约。手表可不会签合同。

text.en: At the all-hands meeting, a colleague presents your three months of work as 'my little side project.' Your slides have your own typos on them.
text.zh: 全员大会上，同事把你三个月的成果当作“我的一个小项目”汇报。PPT 上连你自己的错别字都原封不动。

text.en: Correct them publicly, with timestamps. Justice has excellent lighting.
text.zh: 当众纠正，附时间戳。正义的灯光一向很好。

text.en: Email your boss privately with the file history. Quiet revenge, best served in CC.
text.zh: 私下给老板发邮件，附文件修改记录。安静的复仇，抄送最入味。

text.en: Graduation dust has settled. You receive two concrete full-time offers: a steady Corporate Operations Analyst or a scrappy Boutique Agency Designer.
text.zh: 校園歲月畫上句點。你手握兩份全職員工聘書：一家老牌跨國企業的「維運分析師」，或是新銳小型設計工作室的「視覺設計專員」。

text.en: Take the Corporate Analyst role ($12k salary, stable ladder).
text.zh: 接下企業分析師聘書（年薪穩定，晉升階梯清晰）。

text.en: Join the Boutique Agency (creative freedom, chaotic hours).
text.zh: 加入新銳工作室（創意無限，工時隨性而混亂）。

text.en: Tired of paycheck-to-paycheck anxiety, you map out a strict 50/30/20 budget: home-cooking healthy meals, splitting bulk supplies, and picking up weekend tutoring.
text.zh: 受夠了每個月底的戶頭焦慮，你徹底執行嚴格的 50/30/20 儲蓄法：自煮健康便當、好市多採購分裝，週末還接了高時薪家教。

text.en: Commit fully: meal prep & weekend hustle for solid savings.
text.zh: 全力堅持：健康備餐＋週末兼差，穩穩累積急用基金！

text.en: Find a reliable roommate to cut rent and utility bills in half.
text.zh: 尋找生活規律的好室友，直接將每個月的房租水電砍半！

text.en: A high-stakes cross-departmental initiative is teetering on collapse. Leadership needs someone capable to take ownership and lead the team out of the weeds.
text.zh: 跨部門核心專案面臨進度崩塌危機。高層在週會上環顧四周，急需一位能扛起責任、帶領團隊殺出重圍的得力骨幹。

text.en: Take the reins, deliver the project, and secure the Senior Lead title.
text.zh: 挺身接下燙手山芋，通宵攻堅，順利晉升資深專案主管！

text.en: Deliver your part reliably without absorbing extra corporate politics.
text.zh: 穩妥完成自己負責的模組，絕不主動捲入高層政治風暴。

text.en: After years of shared laughter, quiet weekend brunches, and assembling flat-pack furniture without screaming, your partner brings up formalizing your commitment.
text.zh: 經歷了多年的相濡以沫、雨天早午餐，以及一起組裝家具卻奇蹟般沒吵架後，伴侶在星空下溫柔地向你提出攜手終生的承諾。

text.en: Say yes! Host a warm, joyful wedding with close friends and family.
text.zh: 點頭答應！舉辦一場溫馨浪漫、充滿笑聲的小型婚禮。

text.en: Propose staying devoted life partners without civil registry red tape.
text.zh: 約定不辦繁文縟節的登記，作為純粹的靈魂伴侶同甘共苦。

text.en: Your accumulated savings and steady salary qualify you for prime mortgage rates. A sunlit 2-bedroom apartment near transit just hit the market.
text.zh: 多年穩定的年薪與勤勉儲蓄，讓你拿到了最優惠的首購房貸資格。捷運站旁一間採光極佳的兩房公寓剛剛釋出。

text.en: Put down the 20% deposit and become a proud homeowner.
text.zh: 繳付 20% 首付款，告別租屋生涯，成為有房一族！

text.en: Pass on property: continue renting frugally and auto-invest in index funds.
text.zh: 拒絕當房奴：繼續簡樸租屋，將大筆現金全數自動定額投資指數基金。

text.en: A sudden global restructuring slashes 15% of your company. You are called into a meeting room with HR and offered a generous 6-month severance package.
text.zh: 母公司突發全球架構重組，裁減 15% 員工。HR 在小會議室向你遞上優厚的 6 個月離職資遣補償與推薦信。

text.en: Take the $25,000 severance and launch an independent consulting practice.
text.zh: 領取 25,000 美元資遣費，正式開創個人獨立策略顧問業務！

text.en: Negotiate an immediate internal transfer into the high-margin core group.
text.zh: 憑藉關鍵技術人脈，當場談成平移至高利潤核心產品研發部。

text.en: A sharp, witty industry essay you wrote on LinkedIn/Substack gets picked up by major tech publications, rocketing you to 250,000 readers overnight.
text.zh: 你在社群平台撰寫的產業深度犀利評論，意外被各大財經與科技媒體轉載頭條，一夜之間收穫 25 萬點閱與行業關注！

text.en: Leverage the spotlight: accept paid keynote speeches and book inquiries.
text.zh: 乘勝追擊：接下多場高薪商業演講與專欄邀約，聲名大噪！

text.en: Use the leverage at your annual review to demand a Director-level promotion.
text.zh: 將業界影響力化為內部籌碼，在年度考核中強勢爭取總監級職位！

text.en: An elite executive search firm invites you to an exclusive hotel rooftop dinner. A rapid-growth unicorn wants you as their Vice President with equity.
text.zh: 頂級獵頭公司邀請你在五星級酒店高空餐廳共進晚餐。一家剛完成 C 輪融資的獨角獸企業急需聘請你出任產品副總裁。

text.en: Accept the VP seat, massive salary bump, and equity package.
text.zh: 簽下高管合約，出任副總裁！薪資與期權大幅飆升！

text.en: Politely decline to preserve your peaceful evenings and low blood pressure.
text.zh: 婉拒這場高壓漩渦，堅持傍晚準時下班、身心舒暢的平衡生活。

text.en: Sitting in your 34th consecutive status sync of the week, you look at your calendar. A strange feeling overtakes you: is this all reality has to offer?
text.zh: 坐在本週第 34 場毫無重點的進度同步會議裡，你看著行事曆上密密麻麻的格子，內心浮現出荒誕的哲學詰問：人生就這樣了嗎？

text.en: Take a 3-month paid sabbatical to build a quirky open-source simulation.
text.zh: 申請留職停薪三個月，專心打造一套怪誕有趣的開源人生模擬器。

text.en: Channel the existential dread into founding an internal corporate incubator.
text.zh: 將存在主義焦慮化為野心，在內部立項成立前沿孵化創新團隊！

text.en: You and your partner realize over quiet herbal tea that you have grown into wonderfully different people with opposite life goals. It is time to decide how to proceed.
text.zh: 在一個平靜的週末午後，你與伴侶各自捧著熱茶，坦率地意識到彼此已長成截然不同的人，人生目標漸行漸遠。

text.en: Part ways amicably with mutual respect and split assets cleanly.
text.zh: 平靜好聚好散，理性簽署協議平分財產，祝願彼此前程似錦。

text.en: Commit to couples counseling and rediscover the spark that brought you together.
text.zh: 預約專業婚姻諮商，坦誠溝通，重新找回當年眼裡的熾熱火花。
